Title: Information Security Program Manager
Description:
**Key Responsibilities**

 Plan, lead and manage the end-to-end ISO/IEC 27001 program, including ISMS scope definition, timelines, budget, resources and stakeholder reporting.

 Review existing information security policies, standards, procedures and records to assess completeness and alignment with ISO/IEC 27001:2022 and ISO/IEC 27002.

 Examine current security practices and controls across people, processes and technology to evaluate how effectively they operate in practice.

 Conduct a detailed gap analysis against ISO/IEC 27001 requirements (Clauses 4–10 and Annex A controls) and produce a prioritized remediation roadmap.

 Develop and maintain the information security risk management methodology, and conduct periodic technical risk assessments of applications, infrastructure, networks, cloud services and medical and clinical systems.

 Maintain the information security risk register and risk treatment plans, and track the implementation of treatments with risk and control owners.

 Coordinate periodic vulnerability assessments, penetration tests and configuration reviews, and ensure findings are risk-rated, remediated and verified.

 Establish and manage a CIS-based compliance program, adopting the CIS Critical Security Controls (v8) and CIS Benchmarks as secure configuration baselines for operating systems, databases, network devices, cloud platforms and applications.

 Conduct periodic CIS compliance assessments using automated scanning tools (e.g., CIS-CAT Pro, Tenable, Qualys), track compliance scores against agreed targets, and coordinate remediation or documented exceptions with system owners.

 Prepare and maintain the Statement of Applicability (SoA) and the documentation required for the ISMS, including the ISMS scope, policy, objectives and supporting procedures.

 Assess information security risks of third parties and suppliers, and ensure appropriate security requirements are included in contracts.

 Establish and run the ISMS internal audit program and management reviews, and track

non conformities and corrective actions through to closure.

 Prepare CLIENT for Stage 1 and Stage 2 re-certification audits and ongoing surveillance audits, coordinate with the certification body, and lead the response to any findings.

 Define information security KPIs and metrics, and generate and present periodic (monthly and quarterly) reports covering risk posture, control effectiveness, vulnerability and remediation status, CIS compliance scores, security incidents, audit findings and awareness completion, to support management reviews and decision-making.

 Drive information security awareness and training so that staff understand their responsibilities within the ISMS.

 Ensure the ISMS aligns with CLIENT policies and applicable UAE and Dubai Government information security and data protection requirements, including the UAE Information Assurance Standards, Dubai Electronic Security Center (DESC) requirements and healthcare data regulations.

**Secondary Responsibilities**

 Support the implementation, maintenance and certification of the IT Service Management System (ISO/IEC 20000-1) and the Business Continuity Management System (ISO 22301), working closely with the IT Service Management and Business Continuity teams.

 Align ISMS controls with ITSM processes, including incident, problem, change, configuration, capacity, availability and supplier management.

 Contribute to business impact analysis (BIA), the definition of recovery objectives (RTO/RPO) and continuity risk assessments for critical IT services and information assets.

 Support the development, review and testing of IT service continuity, disaster recovery and business continuity plans, and ensure lessons learned are captured and acted upon.

 Identify opportunities for an integrated management system across ISO/IEC 27001, ISO/IEC 20000-1 and ISO 22301, including shared policies, documentation, internal audits and management reviews.

 Support internal and external audits for ISO/IEC 20000-1 and ISO 22301, including evidence preparation and follow-up of corrective actions.

**Qualifications and Experience**

 Bachelor’s degree in Information Security, Information Technology, Computer Science or a related field.

 [7–10]+ years of experience in information security, including at least [3] years leading ISMS, security risk or compliance programs.

 Proven track record of leading at least one ISO/IEC 27001 implementation or certification.

 In-depth knowledge of ISO/IEC 27001:2022, ISO/IEC 27002 and ISO/IEC 27005, and of risk

assessment methodologies.

 Hands-on experience implementing and assessing the CIS Critical Security Controls and CIS Benchmarks, including the use of configuration compliance scanning tools.

 Solid technical understanding of networks, operating systems, cloud platforms, identity and access management, and security technologies (e.g., firewalls, SIEM, EDR, vulnerability scanners).

 Working knowledge of ISO/IEC 20000-1 and ISO 22301; hands-on implementation or audit experience with these standards is a strong advantage.

 Familiarity with UAE and Dubai information security regulations and healthcare data protection requirements.

 Experience in healthcare or government environments is preferred.

**Preferred Certifications**

 ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Implementer and/or Lead Auditor

 CISSP, CISM or CISA

 ISO/IEC 20000-1 and/or ISO 22301 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor (advantageous)

 CRISC or an equivalent risk management certification (advantageous)

 PMP, PRINCE2 or equivalent project management certification

**Key Competencies**

 Program and change management

 Risk-based thinking and sound technical judgement

 Stakeholder management and ability to influence without direct authority

 Analytical thinking and attention to detail

 Excellent written and verbal communication in English (Arabic is an advantage)

 Facilitation, coaching and training delivery

**About Yalla Bullion**
Yalla Bullion is a digital-first retail bullion dealer, bringing the experience of buying and selling gold and silver online, through our e-commerce store and a wider digital platform. Headquartered in Dubai, we are here to make wealth preservation as easy as ordering a Careem by combining the world's oldest store of value with the high-speed efficiency of modern technology and distribution.
  
  
Yalla Bullion LLC is part of Goldstrom Group. Together we leverage 250+ years of collective expertise and a global "Mine to Market" infrastructure that ensures world-class liquidity and rock-solid trust.
  
  
With a team equipped with deep bullion retail and e-commerce expertise, we use proprietary technology and data to deliver a best-in-class customer experience that sets us apart from our competition.
  
  
We aren't looking for siloed staff ; we are looking for "Builders." We value energy, small-business grit, and those who take pride in building teams and processes.
  
  
**Role Overview**
As Operations Lead you will own the customer journey from first enquiry to delivered order, and every touchpoint in between. That covers customer service, inventory, risk, fulfilment and delivery. You'll run the day-to-day so the business runs like clockwork, and you'll lead, train and upskill the customer service team to deliver world-class service.
  
  
This role suits someone with a warm, people-first personality and a precise, process-driven mind: someone who genuinely enjoys looking after customers and their team, takes pride in getting the detail right every time, and thrives on managing the daily rhythm of an operation.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Customer journey & service**

* Manage the full customer journey from enquiry through order, payment, fulfilment and delivery, and optimise every touchpoint for world-class service.
* Supervise and mentor the customer service team so that support is responsive and best-in-class across WhatsApp, email and telephone.
* Maintain a premium, discreet office environment for in-person clients, with the confidentiality expected in bullion trading.
* Look after office-based B2C and B2B clients buying or selling in person, making sure each transaction follows our process accurately.
* Trading with our suppliers is automated. Make sure the process is followed every time, and monitor it daily for errors or mismatches (price, quantity, settlement), resolving any you find quickly.
* Identify opportunities during face-to-face interactions to introduce clients to storage solutions or larger investment plans.
* Set and track service standards: response times, first-contact resolution, customer reviews and complaint resolution times.
* Own complaints and escalations end-to-end, and make sure every recurring issue gets a root-cause fix, not just an apology.
* Feed the voice of the customer (common questions, objections, friction points) back to the Ecommerce & Marketing Lead to improve the site.

**Team leadership & training**

* Lead, train and upskill the customer service team; build their confidence and product knowledge.
* Run structured onboarding, a training plan and a living knowledge base so that every team member answers the same question the same, correct way.
* Coach regularly against a clear KPI framework, with call/chat quality reviews, one-to-ones and recognition of good work.
* Manage rotas and cover (including weekend and market-volatility peaks) so service never drops.

**Inventory & fulfilment**

* Oversee inventory management and daily reconciliation of digital stock against physical holdings.
* Implement and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for fulfilment, vaulting and asset transfers.
* Liaise with secure logistics providers to ensure safe, on-time delivery.

* Manage supplier and partner relationships (mints, refiners, vaults, insured couriers) and hold them to agreed service levels.
* Own delivery exceptions end-to-end: failed deliveries, damaged or missing parcels, insurance claims and customer communication throughout.
* Run the buyback and returns process, including authenticity checks on items we buy back.
* Track operational KPIs: order-to-dispatch time, on-time delivery, pick/pack accuracy, and stock variance (target: zero).

**Risk & compliance**

* Ensure the team strictly follows established AML and KYC protocols, keeping "audit-ready" documentation for every transaction.
* Manage operational risk across the customer journey.
* Spot and escalate AML red flags and suspicious activity to the Compliance Officer / MLRO, and support UAE regulatory reporting for dealers in precious metals (e.g. via goAML).
* Apply fraud controls: payment fraud, chargebacks, account takeover and counterfeit risk.
* Maintain physical security and stock controls (dual control on stock movements, access logs, regular stock counts and internal audits).
* Keep SOPs current, and make sure the operation could pass an audit on any given day.

**Candidate profile**
**Experience & Background**

* 3–5 years in operations or customer service, including directly managing and training a small-tomidsized team.
* Industry preference: background in luxury retail (e.g. watches, jewellery), bullion or other high-value assets is highly desirable.
* Small business grit: a "no task too small" mentality, rolling up your sleeves to deliver great service for our customers.
* Experience running a high-value or regulated fulfilment operation (insured logistics, vaulting, KYC/AML) is a strong advantage.

**Personality & approach**

* A warm personality: you get real satisfaction from making customers, and your team, happy.
* High attention to detail and a process mind; you notice when something is slightly off and fix it.
* You thrive on managing day-to-day tasks and on a well-run routine, and you improve processes step by step rather than reinventing them.
* You enjoy training people and watching them get better.
* High integrity and discretion: you handle clients' wealth and personal data with care.
* Warm but firm: you can say no politely when a process or compliance rule requires it.
* Calm resilience: you stay calm and assertive during periods of high market price volatility.

**Technical & Soft Skills**

* Languages: full professional proficiency in English is mandatory. Strong Arabic and/or Hindi is highly preferable.
* Tech literacy: proficient with e-commerce backends, inventory management software and CRM tools.
* Comfortable with spreadsheets and reporting, and able to build and read a daily reconciliation.

**Location & working pattern**
This is an office-based role in Dubai; office working is the standard. There is day-to-day flexibility to work remotely when the operation allows, but the operation always comes first.
  
  
**Why join us?**

* Professional growth: opportunity for career advancement into regional roles as we expand across the GCC.
* Impact: direct reporting line to the MD in a performance-driven, high-growth environment.
* Culture: work at the heart of the world's gold capital within a professional, high-security environment.

Title: Network Operations Center (NOC) Lead - Damascus Based
Description:
**Position Objective:**

Define and govern the NOC operating model, ensuring all front-office monitoring and L1 support functions across the fiber network, Core, IT (ITOC), and IXP domains are fully designed, staffed, tooled, and validated ahead of Day-1 launch. Post-launch, the role transitions to governing the MSP NOC function.

**Job Description & Responsibilities:**

Define the NOC operating model —structure, monitoring scope, support processes, shift model, and escalation matrix.

Define monitoring requirements — latency, jitter, packet loss, and availability thresholds triggering alarms, auto-tickets, and escalation.

Define fault management framework — alarm handling/correlation, fault classification, prioritization, ticket creation, TAC escalation, threshold requirements across all monitored domains.

Define the NOC interface to the change management process — planned maintenance visibility, change freeze enforcement, and network change impact monitoring.

Define NOC tooling requirements including OSS, NMS, EMS, monitoring platforms, and real-time dashboard specifications.

Define the interface model between the NOC, TAC, field teams, SecOC, Application Services, and MSPs.

Define NOC procedures for carrier peering and interconnection monitoring across international exchange points and subsea landing stations.

Define NOC KPIs, SLA requirements, and performance reporting framework.

Define staffing levels, skills requirements, and training framework for NOC operators across all domains.

Govern NOC readiness validation — oversee simulations, dry runs, and acceptance criteria sign-off.

Participate in cross-functional OAT (Operational Acceptance Testing) to validate end-to-end NOC readiness for Day-1 launch.

Define the IXP operating model — route server management procedures, peering policy governance, BGP fault handling, and member onboarding interface with the NOC.

**Qualifications & Experience**
:

Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering or a related discipline.

Minimum 10 years in telecommunications network operations, with significant NOC leadership experience.

Strong experience designing or leading a NOC function in a carrier or wholesale infrastructure environment.

Experience defining alarm management frameworks and NOC tooling requirements across converged network and IT environments.

Greenfield or build-to-operate program experience is preferred.

Strong knowledge of NOC operations, monitoring methodologies, and alarm management across network and IT domains.

Experience with IXP operations including route server management, BGP monitoring, and peering policy governance.

Familiarity with NMS/EMS platforms, IT monitoring tools, and ITSM systems.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Strong written and verbal communication in English; Arabic is an advantage.

Experience with MSP governance, vendor performance management, and continual service improvement in NOC operations.

:

Previous leadership experience of 2 or more years managing a team and Project Management experience in their background.

Title: Restoration Manager
Description:
**RESTORATION MANAGER**

  
  

**About telMAX Inc.:**

  

Based in York Region, telMAX is a private equity-backed all fibre digital infrastructure platform that provides a 21st century alternative to traditional telecom networks. Recognized for four consecutive years as Canada’s Fastest ISP with an industry-leading net promoter score of over fifty, telMAX is continuing its rapid growth plan to bring its all-fibre network to residential and business customers across Southern Ontario.

  
  

**Your Position & How You Will Contribute:**

  

The Restoration Manager is responsible for overseeing and managing all restoration activities associated with TelMAX’s Fibre-to-the-Home (FTTH) construction program. This role will have primary accountability for ensuring that all construction vendors complete required restoration work in a timely, safe, compliant, and high-quality manner across all build areas. The Restoration Manager will act as the primary point of contact for restoration activities, coordinating multiple vendors, tracking outstanding deficiencies, managing priorities, and working closely with Construction, Engineering, Municipal Relations, Quality, and other internal teams to ensure restoration requirements are completed and accepted. The successful candidate will be highly organized, field-oriented, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple vendors and competing priorities across a large geographic footprint.

  
  

**Responsibilities & Key Duties:**

  

Restoration Management

  

  
* Own the end-to-end restoration process for all FTTH construction areas.
  
* Develop and maintain a comprehensive inventory of outstanding restoration requirements by area, vendor, project, and municipality.
  
* Establish restoration priorities and drive vendors to complete work within required timelines.
  
* Ensure all restoration activities are completed in accordance with municipal standards, approved construction requirements, permits, and TelMAX standards.
  
* Monitor restoration progress from initial construction through final completion and municipal acceptance.
  
* Identify and escalate restoration risks, delays, deficiencies, and potential compliance issues.
  

  
  

Vendor Management

  

  
* Act as the primary point of contact for vendors responsible for restoration activities.
  
* Establish clear expectations, schedules, deliverables, and completion dates with each vendor.
  
* Hold vendors accountable for outstanding restoration work and deficiencies.
  
* Conduct regular vendor reviews and follow up on overdue or incomplete work.
  
* Coordinate additional resources or corrective action where vendors are unable to meet required timelines.
  
* Track vendor performance and identify recurring quality or performance issues.
  
* Support vendor performance management, including escalation of persistent non-performance to Construction leadership.
  

  
  

Field Coordination & Quality

  

  
* Conduct regular field inspections to verify that restoration work has been completed properly.
  
* Validate that restoration meets municipal, property, and TelMAX requirements.
  
* Coordinate the correction of deficient restoration work with vendors.
  
* Work with municipalities and inspectors to address restoration-related concerns and deficiencies.
  
* Ensure temporary restoration is transitioned to permanent restoration where required.
  
* Confirm that completed restoration is properly documented and ready for municipal inspection or acceptance.
  

  
  

Project Tracking & Reporting

  

  
* Maintain an accurate restoration dashboard showing:
    
    
  + Outstanding restoration items
    
  + Vendor assignments
    
  + Target completion dates
    
  + Aging of outstanding items
    
  + Deficiencies and rework
    
  + Municipal inspection status
    
  + Completed/closed restoration
  
* Provide regular reporting to Construction leadership on restoration progress, risks, and vendor performance.
  
* Establish KPIs and reporting mechanisms to measure restoration performance across the FTTH program.
  
* Identify trends and recurring issues and recommend process improvements.
  

  
  

Municipal & Stakeholder Coordination

  

  
* Work closely with Municipal Relations and Construction teams to understand municipal restoration requirements and deadlines.
  
* Support responses to municipal restoration complaints, deficiencies, and escalations.
  
* Coordinate vendor responses to municipal requirements and inspection findings.
  
* Help ensure restoration commitments made to municipalities are tracked and delivered.
  
* Support the resolution of property-owner restoration concerns where required.
  

  
  

Financial Management

  

  
* Monitor restoration costs and vendor spend against approved budgets.
  
* Identify potential cost overruns, unauthorized work, and additional restoration costs.
  
* Review vendor restoration claims and supporting documentation as required.

Title: Assistant Head of Upper School, Student Support & Wellbeing
Description:
We seek an individual inspired by our mission, whose beliefs align with our core values of integrity, inquiry, compassion and courage, and who reflects our core competencies to join our Upper School as **Assistant Head of Upper School, Student Support & Wellbeing** beginning in August 2027. This is a full-time position.

Salary range: $124,000 to $165,000. The total compensation for this Assistant Head position is based on placement on the Havergal College faculty grid plus a $20,000 leadership stipend (included in the above salary range). Grid placement is determined by teaching qualifications and experience up to a maximum of 11 years. Final placement within the range is based on the successful candidate's credentials and years of experience.

**Why Teach with Us**

At Havergal College, we believe that our strength lies in our faculty and staff's collective efforts, talents, and accomplishments. Together, we can make a positive and lasting impact on our students' lives.

We offer a highly competitive compensation package for teachers, including a faculty teaching grid that is well above the major urban school boards; contributions to and participation in the Ontario Teachers’ Pension Plan and/or Group RSP; generous holidays that allow employees to recharge; comprehensive health and dental benefits; support for professional development including support for graduate work, additional qualifications (AQs), faculty-wide and individual professional development in teaching and learning, wellbeing, equity and inclusion, assessment, and experiential education; and teaching on a beautiful 22-acre campus with excellent facilities.

**Why Havergal is the Place to Be**

Founded in 1894 and located on a beautiful 22-acre campus in midtown Toronto, Canada, Havergal College is one of Canada’s pre-eminent independent schools for girls from Junior Kindergarten through Grade 12.

At Havergal College, we believe great schools are made up of great people. With a rich history spanning over 130 years, we are committed to offering a contemporary liberal arts education rooted in the Anglican tradition. Our mission is to prepare young women to make a difference. Through our outstanding academic and co-curricular programs and a cohesive, collegial team of faculty and administrative staff, we nurture a culture of capability that fosters self-confidence, leadership, critical thinking, and global-mindedness in our students.

We take pride in attracting and retaining highly qualified faculty and administrative staff to ensure our school remains at the forefront of educational excellence. Join us in this transformative education journey, working together to empower young women to make a positive difference in our world.

We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We believe that an inclusive environment fosters a culture of mutual respect, creativity and innovation, collaboration and accountability. To this end, we encourage applications from all qualified candidates with diverse experiences and perspectives, including women, BIPOC (Black, Indigenous and People of Colour) peoples, LGBTQ2S+, and persons with disabilities to join our thriving team. We seek candidates committed to nurturing a community where integrity, compassion, inquiry and courage thrive.

**The Position:**

The Assistant Head of Upper School, Student Support & Wellbeing provides operational leadership for student support and wellbeing across Grades 7–12. Working collaboratively with the Upper School Leadership Team, this role ensures that every student is known, valued, and cared for, and has access to the relationships, resources, and support necessary to thrive academically, socially, and emotionally.

The Assistant Head of Upper School – Student Support & Wellbeing oversees the integrated work of Guidance, Learning Support, Health Services, Social Work and the pastoral dimensions of the Chaplain's role. Through the leadership and development of these teams, the Assistant Head establishes a coordinated and responsive approach to student support that promotes belonging, engagement, inclusion and student success.

Guided by Havergal's Commitment to Wellbeing, the Assistant Head of Upper School – Student Support & Wellbeing leads proactive and preventative approaches to wellbeing across the Upper School, building the capacity of faculty and staff to support students and ensuring effective systems are in place to identify and respond to emerging student needs.

The Assistant Head of Upper School – Student Support & Wellbeing reports directly to the Head of Upper School and is accountable for fostering a safe, equitable and inclusive school culture aligned with Havergal's mission and values. This is a faculty leadership position requiring teaching qualifications and experience in an educational setting.

**Specific Accountabilities:**

**Leadership of Student Support & Wellbeing**

* Lead the development, implementation and ongoing evaluation of a comprehensive, coordinated approach to student support and wellbeing across Grades 7–12, aligned with Havergal's Commitment to Wellbeing.
* Champion proactive, preventative, strengths-based and evidence-informed approaches to wellbeing that promote student belonging, resilience, engagement and healthy development.
* Identify emerging trends in student wellbeing and learning needs, using relevant data, research and professional expertise to inform priorities, programming and resource allocation.
* Partner with the Assistant Heads of Middle and Senior Divisions and the Director of Boarding to ensure that wellbeing priorities are meaningfully embedded in the student experience, including Form, Teacher Advisor, grade-level and Boarding programming.
* Build faculty and staff capacity through professional learning and shared practices that strengthen student wellbeing, inclusive education and effective responses to student needs.
* Contribute to school-wide strategic initiatives that strengthen student wellbeing, inclusive excellence and the overall student experience.

**Leadership and Oversight of Student Support Services**

* Provide leadership, direction and oversight to Guidance, Learning Support, Health Services, Social Work and the pastoral dimensions of the Chaplain's role.
* Lead, coach and develop Student Support leaders and team members, fostering professional growth, collaboration, accountability and continuous improvement.
* Establish clear roles, responsibilities and communication practices across Student Support services to ensure an integrated and effective approach to student care.
* Oversee the effective allocation of staffing, resources and budgets across Student Support services.

The Night Duty Assistant Manager is responsible for overseeing the overall hotel operations during the night shift, ensuring smooth and efficient service delivery, guest satisfaction, safety, security, and compliance with hotel standards and company policies.

The role serves as the senior management representative on duty during nighttime hours, handling guest concerns, managing operational issues, supervising night staff, and ensuring the hotel operates efficiently in the absence of daytime management.

* Ensure proper handover from the evening team to the morning team.
* Make operational decisions in the absence of senior management.

2. Guest Relations and Customer Service

* Welcome VIP guests and ensure special attention is provided where required.
* Handle guest complaints, requests, and service recovery professionally.
* Ensure high levels of guest satisfaction throughout the night.
* Follow up on unresolved guest issues and ensure appropriate corrective action.
* Maintain a visible management presence in the hotel.

3. Front Office and Night Audit

* Supervise night reception and front office activities.
* Ensure smooth check-in and check-out procedures.
* Monitor room availability, occupancy, room status, and arrivals.
* Ensure the night audit is completed accurately and on time.
* Review daily reports, financial transactions, and operational discrepancies.
* Ensure proper cash handling and compliance with financial procedures.

* Monitor incidents, unusual activities, and emergency situations.
* Ensure compliance with fire safety, health and safety, and emergency procedures.
* Act as the incident coordinator during emergencies until the relevant senior management or emergency services take over.
* Complete incident reports and escalate serious matters immediately.

5. Team Management and Supervision

* Supervise and support all employees working during the night shift.
* Ensure adequate staffing and effective allocation of duties.
* Monitor employee attendance, grooming, conduct, and performance.
* Motivate team members and maintain a professional working environment.
* Address operational and staff-related issues appropriately.
* Ensure proper communication and handover between shifts.

6. Financial and Administrative Responsibilities

* Monitor overnight revenue and financial transactions.
* Ensure accurate completion of daily revenue and night audit reports.
* Investigate discrepancies and report irregularities.
* Ensure compliance with company financial controls and procedures.
* Maintain accurate records of incidents, guest complaints, and operational activities.

7. Reporting and Communication

* Prepare and submit the Night Manager's Daily Report.
* Communicate important operational updates to the Hotel Manager and relevant department heads.
* Highlight maintenance issues, guest concerns, security incidents, and outstanding matters.
* Ensure a detailed handover to the morning management team.

Qualifications and Experience

* Diploma or bachelor's degree in hospitality management, Hotel Management, or a related field.
* Minimum 3–5 years of experience in hotel operations, preferably in a supervisory or management position.
* Previous experience as a Duty Manager, Night Manager, or Assistant Front Office Manager is preferred.
* Strong knowledge of front office operations, night audit, and hotel management systems.
* Knowledge of hotel health, safety, security, and emergency procedures.
* Experience in handling guest complaints and managing operational challenges.

Required Skills and Competencies

* Strong leadership and team management skills.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities.
* Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
* Excellent guest relations and conflict-resolution skills.
* Strong attention to detail and organizational abilities.
* Ability to remain calm and effective under pressure.
* Good knowledge of Microsoft Office and hotel PMS systems.
* Excellent written and spoken English.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The Night Duty Manager will be evaluated based on:

* Guest satisfaction and complaint resolution.
* Smooth and efficient overnight hotel operations.
* Accuracy and timely completion of night audit.
* Compliance with company policies and operational standards.
* Security, safety, and incident management.
* Staff supervision and performance.
* Quality of daily reports and shift handovers.
* Reduction of operational errors and financial discrepancies.

Authority and Accountability

The Night Duty Assistant Manager is authorized to:

* Make operational decisions during the night shift.
* Handle guest complaints and approve service recovery within company guidelines.
* Coordinate all departments and allocate available resources.
* Take immediate action in emergency situations.
* Escalate major financial, security, guest-related, or operational matters to senior management.

Overall Accountability: To ensure the hotel front office operates safely, efficiently, and professionally throughout the night, while maintaining the company's service standards, protecting its assets, and delivering an excellent guest experience.

Description:
**Req Id:**
433116
  
  
Tout part d’une connexion. Elle nous pousse à innover, à explorer et à rester proches de ce qui compte le plus pour nous. Chez Bell, nous bâtissons un avenir plus connecté grâce à des réseaux de calibre mondial, à des solutions propulsées par l’IA et à des expériences numériques qui améliorent la façon dont les gens vivent, travaillent et se divertissent chaque jour.
  
  
Nous croyons à l’autonomisation de chacun. C’est pourquoi nous dotons nos équipes d’une technologie de pointe, d’outils d’IA et d’un environnement collaboratif qui soutient la créativité et la croissance. Voulez-vous faire partie d’une équipe diversifiée où votre travail a un réel impact? Si vous êtes inspiré par l’innovation qui fait progresser la façon dont les gens se connectent et transforme ce qui est possible, vous avez votre place au sein de l’#ÉquipeBell.
  
  
Au sein de l’équipe Bell Marchés Affaires, vous jouerez un rôle essentiel en matière d’innovation pour notre clientèle d’entreprises. Vous livrerez des solutions évoluées dans des domaines comme l’Internet des objets, la mobilité et la 5G, l’infonuagique, la cybersécurité, les services vocaux, la collaboration et les centres de contact, ainsi que l’Internet et les réseaux privés.
  
  
Vos compétences et votre expertise aideront Bell à se démarquer alors que nous restons le premier fournisseur de connexions numériques et de services de prochaine génération pour les entreprises et les gouvernements.
  
  
**Résumé**
**Programme IA Fabric de Bell**
est une initiative de transformation visant à déployer une infrastructure de centres de données évolutive et essentielle aux opérations. Le
**gestionnaire, contrôle de programme**
sera responsable d’établir et de maintenir les processus de gouvernance qui assurent la coordination entre les différents services, projets et parties prenantes du programme.
  
  
Relevant du ou de la
**directeur, contrôle de programme**
, cette personne fournira un leadership dans les domaines suivants : la gestion des interfaces et des transferts, la gouvernance des risques, l’analyse des causes fondamentales, la capitalisation des leçons apprises, l’amélioration continue, la gestion des mesures de suivi ainsi que la coordination du contrôle des changements.
  
  
Le titulaire du poste contribuera à maintenir une vision intégrée et fiable des risques, des dépendances, des actions et des initiatives d’amélioration du programme afin de soutenir une exécution prévisible et efficace des projets.
  
  
**Principales responsabilités**
**Gestion des interfaces et des transferts**

* Administrer le registre des transferts et interdépendances du programme.
* Coordonner les revues interfonctionnelles entre les équipes de développement, d’ingénierie, d’approvisionnement, de construction, de mise en service, d’exploitation, de sécurité, des TI et les parties prenantes réglementaires.
* Surveiller les dépendances, les critères d’entrée et de sortie ainsi que les exigences de transfert à chaque phase du projet.
* Identifier et signaler les enjeux liés aux dépendances, aux livrables, aux responsabilités et aux étapes critiques.

**Gestion des risques et analyse des causes fondamentales**

* Maintenir le registre RAID du programme et soutenir les processus de gouvernance des risques.
* Coordonner les revues de risques, le suivi des mesures d’atténuation et les actions correctives.
* Diriger ou faciliter les analyses des causes fondamentales pour les enjeux majeurs ayant un impact sur les coûts, les échéanciers ou la performance.
* Analyser les tendances et recommander des mesures préventives ou correctives.

**Leçons apprises et amélioration continue**

* Développer et maintenir un cadre structuré de leçons apprises.
* Recueillir et intégrer les apprentissages aux principaux jalons du programme.
* Traduire les leçons retenues en améliorations des procédures, normes, outils et pratiques de livraison.
* Animer des ateliers et revues visant l’amélioration continue et l’efficacité des contrôles.

**Gestion des actions et gouvernance**

* Mettre en place un processus de suivi des actions à boucle fermée.
* Veiller à ce que les actions, risques, décisions et initiatives d’amélioration soient assignés, suivis et clôturés adéquatement.
* Assurer des suivis réguliers et fournir à la direction une visibilité sur les enjeux, retards et décisions requises.

**Gestion du changement**

* Coordonner le processus de contrôle des changements et les évaluations d’impact.
* Assurer l’alignement des changements avec les risques, les dépendances, les transferts et les références du programme.
* Maintenir des registres, journaux de décisions et rapports de gouvernance vérifiables.

**Rapports et soutien au contrôle de programme**

* Produire des tableaux de bord et rapports exécutifs sur les risques, les interfaces, les actions, les changements et les initiatives d’amélioration.
* Soutenir les cycles de gouvernance et de reddition de comptes du programme.
* Fournir des analyses sur les tendances, les dépendances et les risques émergents.
* Contribuer à la mise en œuvre et à l’amélioration continue des processus, outils, normes et pratiques de contrôle de programme.
* Agir comme point central d’intégration de l’information tout en assurant l’imputabilité des équipes responsables de la livraison.

**Qualifications Essentielles**

* Expérience progressive en contrôle de programme, contrôle de projet, gestion de bureau de projets (PMO), gestion des risques, gouvernance de programme, amélioration continue ou réalisation de grands projets d’investissement (CAPEX).
* Expérience démontrée dans la coordination de programmes ou de projets complexes et multidisciplinaires impliquant plusieurs équipes internes, consultants, entrepreneurs et fournisseurs.
* Solide compréhension des pratiques de gestion des risques, des enjeux, des mesures correctives, des changements, des interfaces et de la gouvernance.
* Expérience dans l’animation d’analyses des causes profondes (Root Cause Analysis) et dans la mise en œuvre et le suivi d’actions correctives jusqu’à leur résolution.
* Capacité à intégrer les données liées aux échéanciers, aux coûts, aux risques, aux changements et au transfert des livrables afin d’offrir une vision globale et intégrée du programme.
* Excellentes compétences analytiques, organisationnelles, d’animation et de gestion des parties prenantes.
* Capacité à communiquer clairement des informations complexes et à produire des rapports concis destinés à la haute direction.
* Maîtrise des outils Microsoft 365 et bonne connaissance des systèmes de contrôle de projets et de production de rapports.

**Qualifications Souhaitées**

* Expérience dans le soutien à la réalisation de projets de centres de données, d’infrastructures critiques (mission-critical), de télécommunications ou d’infrastructures hyperscale.
* Connaissance du cycle de vie des centres de données, incluant la planification, la conception, l’approvisionnement, la construction, la mise en service (commissioning), la préparation opérationnelle et le transfert aux équipes d’exploitation.
* Connaissance des environnements critiques liés aux systèmes électriques, mécaniques, de refroidissement, d’automatisation et contrôle, de réseaux et de sécurité.
* Expérience avec les outils Primavera P6, Power BI, EcoSys, Procore, SAP, SharePoint ou d’autres plateformes similaires de contrôle de projets.
* Certification professionnelle PMP (Project Management Professional), PMI-RMP (PMI Risk Management Professional), PSP (Planning & Scheduling Professional), CCP (Certified Cost Professional), Lean Six Sigma ou certification équivalente

**Exigences supplémentaires**

* Leadership transversal et capacité à influencer et mobiliser les parties prenantes sans autorité hiérarchique directe.
* Excellentes aptitudes en résolution structurée de problèmes et solide jugement professionnel.
* Sens des responsabilités, rigueur dans le suivi des dossiers et grande attention aux détails.
* Capacité à remettre en question de façon constructive, à formuler des recommandations pertinentes et à escalader les enjeux avec clarté lorsque nécessaire.
* Excellentes habiletés de communication avec la haute direction et capacité à présenter des analyses et recommandations fondées sur les données.
* Mentalité d’amélioration continue et engagement envers l’apprentissage organisationnel et le partage des meilleures pratiques.

Title: Construction Manager
Description:
**Company Description**

Egis is a leading global architectural, consulting, construction engineering, operations and mobility services firm. We create and operate intelligent infrastructure and buildings that both respond to the climate emergency and contribute to balanced, sustainable and resilient development.

Our 23,500 employees operate across over 70 countries, deploying their expertise to develop and deliver cutting-edge innovations and solutions for clients. Through the wide range of our activities, we are central to the collective organisation of society and the living environment of citizens all over the world.

 **Job Description**

**Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:**

* Coordinates and supervises the construction process from the conceptual development stage through final construction, making sure that the project is completed on time.
* Evaluates and helps determine appropriate construction delivery systems and the most cost-effective plan and schedule for completing the project
* Oversees the performance of all trade contractors and is responsible for ensuring that all work is completed on schedule.
* Direct the work for Sr. Architectural, Electrical, Structural & Mechanical and other sub-ordinates, in arranging review of shop drawings, method statements, material and site inspections, as-built drawings, O & M Manuals, warranties, etc.,
* Monitoring suitability and availability of drawings and other data to ensure the contractor has the right information for the work in hand.
* Monitoring the quality and timeliness of inspections carried out by the consultant.
* Monitoring contractors for compliance with their contractual responsibilities.
* Monitoring progress of the works for compliance with schedule.
* Ensuring that appropriate planning tools are implemented by the contractor, including accurate look ahead schedules.
* Ensuring that materials for the works are submitted for approval in time, delivered on time and suitably stored on site prior to incorporation in the works.

**About Fluidstack**
====================

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

  

**We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!**

**How We Operate**
==================

* **Be a barrel.** Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.
* **Insane urgency.** We drive everything forward as fast as possible.
* **Reason from first principles.** Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.
* **Love of the game.** The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.
* **Build something that actually matters.** If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

**About the Role**
==================

You will be Fluidstack's safety authority on the ground — our owner's representative embedded in active major construction projects. That means managing GCs and EPCs directly, owning the high-risk activity review process, and protecting Fluidstack's interests across complex, concurrent construction environments that include heavy civil and data center builds.

Current assignments are in Lubbock and Abernathy, Texas. As those projects complete, you move to the next capital project. Ongoing travel is approximately 50%. You report to the HSE Director and operate with the authority to stop work, issue owner-level directives, and escalate to ownership without friction.

This is not a compliance coordination role. You are in the field, holding major contractors accountable, running HRAs, leading incident investigations, and giving leadership clear visibility into what is actually happening on site.

**Responsibilities**
====================

**Own safety on the owner's side**

* Serve as Fluidstack's safety authority on active construction sites — the person GCs and EPCs answer to on HSE matters, not the other way around.

* Review and approve or reject contractor safety plans, site-specific programs, and high-risk work packages before work starts.

* Conduct structured site inspections and formal audits of GC, EPC, and subcontractor operations; issue written corrective action notices on behalf of Fluidstack.

* Stop work when conditions demand it. Manage resumption through verified corrective action. Communicate clearly to site leadership and the HSE Director.

* Attend construction progress and coordination meetings as Fluidstack's HSE representative; hold contractors to their performance commitments.

* Manage the safety interface across multi-contractor, multi-EPC project environments — concurrent scope, shared hazard zones, and multi-employer coordination.

**Lead high-risk activity reviews**

* Own the formal High Risk Activity (HRA) review process for critical work phases: energized electrical systems, critical and engineered lifts, confined space entry, deep excavations, structural steel erection, high work, and hot work in sensitive areas.

* Review and approve contractor lift plans, rigging studies, shoring designs, confined space programs, and energy control procedures on Fluidstack's behalf.

* Run pre-construction and phase-gate hazard assessments for major project scopes; verify controls are documented and in place before work begins.

* Lead pre-task planning sessions for high-consequence activities — ensure JHAs reflect actual field conditions, not just paperwork.

* Maintain a live project risk register: open hazards, assigned controls, responsible contractor, verification status.

**Manage GC and EPC safety performance**

* Pre-qualify GC and EPC safety programs through rigorous review of EMR history, TRIR/LTIR trends, written program quality, key personnel, and track record on comparable project types.

* Track contractor safety performance throughout execution — leading indicators, near-miss rates, inspection findings, CAPA closure rates — and report trends to the HSE Director.

* Issue formal performance notices, cure letters, and escalation recommendations when GC or EPC safety performance falls below contractual standards.

* Verify that all contractors conduct required orientations, toolbox talks, task-specific training, and competency checks for their workforce.

* Feed contractor safety performance data directly into contract management decisions — scope adjustments, payment holds, and formal remedies.

**Investigate incidents and manage regulatory exposure**

* Respond to and manage all incidents on assigned sites — near-misses, first-aids, recordables, property damage, and environmental releases — regardless of which contracted party is involved.

* Lead formal root-cause investigations; produce written reports and present findings and corrective actions to the HSE Director and ownership.

* Serve as Fluidstack's interface with OSHA and other agencies on assigned projects; manage citation response and abatement in coordination with legal.

* Maintain OSHA recordkeeping compliance across the project; track TRIR/LTIR by contractor and report to the HSE Director on a regular cadence.

**Maintain regulatory compliance**

* Working knowledge of OSHA 29 CFR 1926 (Construction), 29 CFR 1910 (General Industry), and NFPA 70E is a baseline — you apply it, you don't reference it.

* Ensure site-specific environmental compliance is met: SWPPP, SPCC, waste management, and air quality requirements as applicable to each project.

* Advise the HSE Director proactively on regulatory obligations ahead of upcoming project phases — not reactively after work starts.

**Emergency preparedness**

* Ensure every assigned site has a current, site-specific Emergency Action Plan — evacuation, fire, medical, severe weather, utility strikes, and spill/release.

* Coordinate drills with GC and EPC teams; debrief findings and drive updates to plans.

* Act as Fluidstack's incident commander or primary support during actual emergencies on site.

**Report to the HSE Director**

* Weekly field observation reports, monthly safety dashboards, and post-incident summaries — on time, in writing, without prompting.

* Translate field conditions into owner-level intelligence: what the risk is, what the contractor is doing, what needs to be directed, and what happens if it isn't.

* Maintain audit-ready project safety documentation: inspection records, corrective action logs, HRA packages, training verification, and incident files.

**Basic Qualifications**
========================

* 5+ years of construction safety experience, with meaningful time in an owner's representative or safety oversight role on major capital construction projects.

* Demonstrated experience managing GC and EPC safety compliance — pre-qualification, audits, corrective action, and escalation — on large, complex builds.

* Hands-on experience leading formal HRA reviews and pre-task planning for high-consequence construction operations.

* Deep working knowledge of OSHA 29 CFR 1926 and 1910, NFPA 70E, and how they apply to real field conditions on heavy civil and industrial sites.

* Proven formal incident investigation methodology — root-cause analysis you can defend in front of ownership and regulators.

* Willing to stop work, hold the line with major contractors, and escalate without hesitation.

* ~50% domestic travel. No exceptions. Texas Remote strongly preferred.

* Bachelor's degree in Occupational Safety & Health, Construction Management, Engineering, or equivalent field experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* CSP, ASP, or CHST — or active BCSP candidacy.

* OSHA 500 or 510 (Authorized Trainer); OSHA 30-Hour Construction minimum.

* Direct experience on data center, heavy civil, industrial, oil & gas, or pipeline construction — particularly in Texas.

* Bilingual English and Spanish — strongly preferred given Texas construction workforce demographics.

Title: Construction Manager

We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. **Purpose**
-----------

  

We are currently recruiting for a Construction Manager to support the successful delivery of capital projects across the mining, renewable energy, clean energy, traditional energy, chemicals, and industrial sectors.

The Construction Manager is responsible for leading site-based construction execution and ensuring projects are delivered safely, efficiently, and in accordance with project scope, schedule, budget, quality, and regulatory requirements. This role provides leadership to construction teams, contractors, subcontractors, and field support personnel while serving as the primary construction interface between the project site, project management team, engineering disciplines, procurement, customers, and key stakeholders.

The successful candidate will bring strong construction leadership experience, a commitment to health, safety, and environmental excellence, and the ability to manage complex multidisciplinary projects through construction, commissioning, startup, and turnover.

  

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

### **Construction Leadership and Execution**

  

* Lead all site construction activities in accordance with project objectives, execution plans, schedules, budgets, and quality requirements.
* Provide overall leadership and direction to construction teams, contractors, subcontractors, and field supervision personnel.
* Develop and implement project construction execution strategies, construction management plans, staffing plans, and site mobilization plans.
* Coordinate construction activities to ensure efficient execution and alignment with project milestones.
* Monitor productivity, workforce performance, and construction progress against project targets.
* Identify schedule risks, execution challenges, and resource constraints and implement mitigation and recovery plans as required.
* Support construction readiness planning and ensure appropriate work packaging and workface planning processes are in place.
* Participate in project planning, risk assessments, constructability reviews, and execution strategy development from early project phases through project completion.

### **Health, Safety, Environment and Quality**

  

* Champion a strong safety culture and ensure all work is executed in accordance with project and corporate health, safety, environmental, and security requirements.
* Promote visible safety leadership and participation throughout all stages of project execution.
* Lead safety meetings, field observations, incident reviews, and corrective action implementation.
* Ensure all contractors and subcontractors comply with project safety standards and regulatory requirements.
* Support environmental stewardship and compliance with applicable permits and regulations.
* Ensure construction activities comply with approved quality management systems, inspection requirements, and project specifications.
* Support quality audits, inspections, and verification processes throughout project execution.

### **Engineering, Procurement and Construction Integration**

  

* Collaborate closely with Project Management, Engineering, Procurement, Project Controls, and Commissioning teams to ensure effective project delivery.
* Participate in constructability reviews, model reviews, design reviews, and risk assessments.
* Provide construction input into engineering deliverables, installation methodologies, schedules, and sequencing strategies.
* Ensure construction teams receive required engineering deliverables, materials, equipment, and information to support efficient execution.
* Coordinate resolution of field technical issues and construction-related requests for information.
* Support implementation and management of project change processes and management of change requirements.
* Monitor material availability, equipment delivery, and procurement activities to identify and mitigate potential impacts to construction execution.

### **Contractor and Stakeholder Management**

  

* Develop and maintain effective working relationships with customers, contractors, subcontractors, suppliers, regulatory agencies, Indigenous communities, and other project stakeholders.
* Manage contractor performance related to safety, quality, schedule, productivity, and cost objectives.
* Facilitate regular construction coordination meetings and communicate project priorities and expectations.
* Support contract administration activities, including scope reviews, change management, claims mitigation, and performance evaluations.
* Serve as the primary site representative and construction point of contact for project stakeholders.

### **Project Controls and Reporting**

  

* Monitor construction progress, productivity, staffing levels, schedule performance, and cost trends.
* Collaborate with Project Controls to maintain construction schedules, forecasts, and progress measurement systems.
* Review and evaluate progress reports, productivity metrics, and key performance indicators.
* Support development of mitigation and recovery plans when schedule or productivity challenges arise.
* Provide regular reporting on construction performance, risks, opportunities, and project status.
* Ensure accurate documentation of field activities, changes, non-conformances, inspections, and project records.

### **Commissioning, Startup and Project Closeout**

  

* Support construction completion, mechanical completion, commissioning, startup, and turnover activities.
* Coordinate punch list management and completion of outstanding construction activities.
* Ensure as-built documentation, turnover packages, quality records, and completion documentation are properly managed and submitted.
* Support successful transfer of facilities to operations teams and customers.

### **Team Leadership and Development**

  

* Build and maintain a high-performance project team focused on safety, quality, accountability, and project delivery.
* Mentor, coach, and develop construction personnel and emerging leaders.
* Promote collaboration and effective communication across all project functions.
* Support workforce planning, succession planning, and talent development initiatives.
* Foster an inclusive and respectful work environment that encourages engagement and continuous improvement.

**What You Will Bring**
-----------------------

### **Technical and Industry Experience**

  

* Experience leading construction execution on major capital projects within one or more of the following sectors:
  + Mining and Minerals Processing
  + Traditional Energy (Oil & Gas, Refining, Petrochemical)
  + Renewable Energy (Wind, Solar, Hydro)
  + Clean Energy (Hydrogen, Carbon Capture, Biofuels, Energy Transition)
  + Chemicals
  + Infrastructure, Utilities, Manufacturing, or Heavy Industrial Facilities
* Demonstrated success managing multidisciplinary construction teams on complex projects.
* Strong understanding of construction management practices, field execution, contractor management, and project delivery processes.
* Experience supporting projects through construction, commissioning, startup, and turnover.
* Strong understanding of construction scheduling, workface planning, productivity management, and construction work packaging.
* Experience leading constructability reviews and construction planning activities.
* Strong understanding of health, safety, environmental, and quality management systems.
* Experience with EPC and EPCM project delivery models.
* Knowledge of contract administration, change management, risk management, and construction controls.
* Ability to interpret engineering drawings, specifications, schedules, contracts, and technical documentation.
* Strong leadership, communication, stakeholder management, negotiation, and conflict resolution skills.
* Proficiency with Primavera P6, Microsoft Project, and Microsoft Office applications is considered an asset.
* Willingness and ability to travel and work at client sites and remote project locations as required.

### **Education and Qualifications**

#### **Required**

  

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Engineering Technology, Project Management, or a related discipline.
* Significant experience managing industrial construction projects.
* Demonstrated leadership experience in complex construction environments.

#### **Preferred**

  

* Professional Engineer (P.Eng.) designation.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
* Construction safety certifications or related health and safety qualifications.
* Previous experience in EPC or EPCM project environments.
* Experience supporting major greenfield and brownfield capital projects.

* R&D & Innovation

+ Identify and prototype the next AI capability Snoonu should dominate — from experiment to validated proof-of-concept with clear go/no-go criteria.

**Education**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, AI, Software Engineering, or a related field.

**Experience**

* 6–10 years of software engineering experience, with at least 3 years in a tech lead or engineering management role.
* Demonstrated track record of shipping production conversational AI, IVR, or agentic systems end-to-end — not just models, but the full stack from architecture to monitoring. Portfolio, GitHub, or detailed case studies required.
* Hands-on experience with multi-agent orchestration on AWS Bedrock or equivalent agentic frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen).
* Prior experience leading a team of 3–8 engineers, with a coaching-first approach to technical growth.

Title: Planning Manager- Food/ Demand Planner
Description:
**Job Requisition ID:** 183582

About Al-Futtaim
  
Established in the 1930s, Al-Futtaim is one of the most diversified and progressive privately held regional businesses, headquartered in Dubai. Operating across more than 20 countries, the Group spans automotive, financial services, real estate, retail and health. With more than 40,000 employees, Al-Futtaim represents over 200 of the world’s most recognised brands, including Toyota, Lexus, IKEA, ACE and Marks & Spencer. Driven by its purpose to enrich lives and elevate communities, Al-Futtaim focuses on digital innovation, AI, sustainable growth and strategic partnerships, creating long-term value for customers, communities and partners while building a responsible legacy for future generations.

  

**Overview Of The Role:**

* The Demand Planner for M&S Food MENA is responsible for delivering precise demand forecasts to ensure the optimal stock volumes reach every product, store, and channel, actively contributing to meeting availability and waste targets. Utilizing RELEX, the planner optimizes system-led forecasting parameters, focuses on genuine exceptions, and collaborates closely with Category Managers and Supply Chain for smooth commercial alignment. The role requires adept incorporation of promotions and regional events into forecasts while upholding high standards of forecasting accuracy and bias minimization. It also involves a strong emphasis on planning master data accuracy and the effective adoption of new forecasting capabilities, influencing stock levels tied to significant annual sales values in AED.
  

**What You Will Do:**

#### **Forecasting**

  

* Deliver accurate, unbiased forecasts for assigned categories such as Chilled, Ambient & Frozen using RELEX, considering sales trends, seasonality, and customer behavior.
* Configure and optimize forecasting parameters within RELEX to ensure planner focus on genuine exceptions, aiming to maximize forecast release without manual overrides.
* Incorporate promotions, range changes, new product launches, trading plans, and regional events into forecasts prior to cut-off, ensuring the accuracy of promotional forecasts and new-line forecasts in the early weeks.
* Explain variances with clear root causes, agree upon and deliver improvement actions, and conduct monthly accuracy reviews.
* Align commercially with Category Managers to ensure one agreed demand view and flag supply constraints early with the Supply Chain team.
* Maintain accurate and current forecasting master data, including lead times, delivery schedules, and product lifecycle data.
* Drive RELEX adoption and capability by executing effective UAT, logging enhancements, and coaching colleagues on best practices.
  

**Required Skills To Be Successful:**

* Strong analytical and data skills, including advanced Excel, Power BI/Tableau; SQL or Python skills desirable.
* Ability to work with AI/ML driven forecasts, questioning the system with evidence rather than habitually overriding.
* Structured problem-solving skills focused on identifying root causes.
* Excellent communication skills for presenting forecasts and analysis to senior stakeholders.
  

**What Qualifies You For The Role:**

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Business, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Engineering, or related field.
* 3-5 years of experience in demand planning or forecasting, particularly in food/grocery retail or FMCG environments with short-shelf-life products.
* Hands-on experience with advanced planning systems, preferably RELEX, as well as familiarity with regional trading patterns and events.
* Professional certification such as ASCM CPIM or IBF CPF is desirable, along with system implementation or UAT experience.

At Al-Futtaim Retail, we are part of a 90-year legacy built on ambition, progress and long-term vision. As one of the region’s leading retail operators, we partner with some of the world’s most trusted brands – including IKEA, ACE, Marks & Spencer and the Inditex Group – bringing global excellence to customers across MENA and Southeast Asia.

We don’t just operate stores; we shape retail experiences. From launching brands like Watsons and Kiabi to our regions for the first time, to investing in digital innovation, AI capabilities, the customer experience and loyalty platforms, we are constantly redefining the future of retail.

With over 100 nationalities spread across more than 10 countries, our strength lies in our diverse and collaborative community. Here, you’re equipped to turn your ambition into action, building the career you want, while helping us move retail forwards.

Join us and be part of The Heart of Tomorrow.

Title: Sr. Canada SMB Marketing Manager, Amazon Ads
Description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Re-imagine advertising with Amazon. Amazon Ads offers a rich array of digital advertising solutions with the goal of helping our customers find and discover anything they want to buy. We help advertisers reach Amazon customers on Amazon owned and operated sites and on other high quality sites across the web. We start with the customer and work backwards in everything we do, including advertising. If you’re interested in joining a rapidly growing team working to build a unique, world-class advertising product with a relentless focus on the customer, you’ve come to the right place.  
  
A strategically important part of our charter is to drive adoption across a portfolio of self-service, cost per click advertising products to enable head to tail advertisers to engage with customers in relevant ways. Our team is tasked with making it easy for prospective and current advertisers to increase visibility of their products and services, which also helps Amazon customers discover more selection—a win-win!  
  
Within our growing Amazon Ads Marketing organization, we are seeking an experienced Sr Marketing Manager to join our Global Small Business (SMB) Americas team. This leader is responsible for developing and executing comprehensive marketing 3P Canada Store partnership strategies that work backwards from the needs of SMB customers and drive consideration of our advertising solutions and supporting programs. The Sr. Manager will accomplish this by deeply understanding our product portfolio, develop comprehensive marketing strategies, and deliver multi-channel marketing campaigns to support their vision. The right candidate will be collaborative, results oriented, relentlessly focused on the customer, has the ability to make trade-offs, and executes with high standards. They will be passionate about owning a new initiative and able to manage stakeholder feedback, develop goals based on inputs, and track success by standing up mechanisms and creating metrics. The Sr. Marketing Manager will report out on program health regularly to key stakeholders and partner teams across the Amazon Ads organization.  
  
This is a cross-functional role that requires close partnership across 3P Store, Product Marketing, Ad Product and Tech, and Legal/PR. Success in this role requires having a passion for SMBs, as well as a strong backbone, great communication skills, both verbal and written, and the ability to deal with a significant amount of ambiguity.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Responsible for 3P Canada Stores' campaign strategies that articulate insights, and provide measurable creative and business content strategies
* Lead campaign framework development to inform 3P channel strategies, analytics and measuring success, and educatainment strategies for tent pole initiatives
* Responsible for execution and implementation of marketing strategies that support the SMB marketing work with 3P stores
* Connect the dots between business goals, customer insights, marketing strategies, and creative development

Description:
**Ready to make your next big professional move? Join us on our journey to achieve our big dream of building the most loved restaurant brands in the world.**

  

Restaurant Brands International Inc. is one of the world's largest quick service restaurant companies with nearly $49 billion in annual system-wide sales and over 33,000 restaurants in more than 120 countries and territories.

RBI owns four of the world's most prominent and iconic quick service restaurant brands – TIM HORTONS®, BURGER KING®, POPEYES®, and FIREHOUSE SUBS®. These independently operated brands have been serving their respective guests, franchisees and communities for decades. Through its Restaurant Brands for Good framework, RBI is improving sustainable outcomes related to its food, the planet, and people and communities.

RBI is committed to growing the TIM HORTONS®, BURGER KING®, POPEYES® and FIREHOUSE SUBS® brands by leveraging their respective core values, employee and franchisee relationships, and long track records of community support. Each brand benefits from the global scale and shared best practices that come from ownership by Restaurant Brands International Inc.

Restaurant Brands International is seeking a Senior Manager, Marketing Communications to join the Tim Hortons Canada Marketing team on a 14-month contract covering a parental leave. This role leads the day-to-day development and delivery of integrated communications for national brand, product and promotional campaigns. The Senior Manager turns business priorities and guest insights into clear briefs, distinctive creative and coordinated in-market execution that supports traffic and sales and builds brand affinity.

The successful candidate will work closely with category, media, digital and loyalty, public relations, operations, field teams, franchisees and agency partners. They will bring sound creative judgment, strong project leadership and a practical understanding of what it takes to deliver effective work across a large restaurant system.

**Responsibilities**

**Integrated campaign leadership**

* Lead the development and execution of integrated communications plans for national brand, product and promotional campaigns, from brief through launch and post-campaign review.
* Translate business objectives, guest insights and marketing priorities into focused communication strategies, creative briefs, channel requirements and launch plans.
* Coordinate campaign work across paid, owned and earned channels, including digital, social, public relations, influencer, CRM and loyalty, in-restaurant, sponsorship and franchisee-facing communications, in partnership with the teams that own those channels.

**Creative and brand stewardship**

* Guide agency partners through concept development, creative refinement, production and final delivery; provide clear, timely feedback that strengthens the work and protects the creative idea.
* Champion the Tim Hortons brand voice, identity and positioning, ensuring communications are distinctive, simple, human and consistent across touchpoints.
* Assess creative against the brief, guest needs, brand standards, campaign objectives and the broader in-market communications picture.

**Production and campaign delivery**

* Manage campaign timelines, deliverables, dependencies, approvals and budgets, anticipating risks and resolving issues before they affect launch.
* Oversee the development and production of campaign assets, including briefing, production planning, legal review, stakeholder approvals, localization and delivery to channel teams.
* Ensure work is accurate, operationally executable and ready for restaurants and guests across Canada.

**Partnership and agency management**

* Build effective working relationships with creative, production, PR, social, influencer and other agency partners; set clear expectations for quality, timing, scope and cost.
* Partner with Category Marketing, Product Innovation, Media, Digital and Loyalty, Analytics, Operations, Field, Legal, Finance and franchisees to align communications with business needs and restaurant realities.
* Coordinate with French-language and other channel teams to support consistent, market-ready campaign delivery.

**Measurement and continuous improvement**

* Work with analytics and channel partners to define campaign KPIs, monitor in-market performance and identify opportunities to improve effectiveness.
* Lead post-campaign reviews, capture learnings and apply them to future creative, channel plans and ways of working.
* Monitor consumer, cultural, media and QSR trends to identify relevant opportunities for Tim Hortons in Canada.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, business or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
* At least 5 years of progressive experience in integrated marketing, marketing communications, brand marketing or advertising.
* Experience leading multi-channel campaigns from strategy and briefing through production, launch and measurement.
* Strong creative judgment and the ability to give clear, constructive feedback to agency and internal partners.
* Experience managing agency relationships, project budgets, timelines, approvals and multiple concurrent priorities.
* Excellent written, verbal, presentation and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong organization and follow-through, with the ability to make sound decisions and adapt in a fast-paced environment.
* Ability to work effectively with senior leaders, cross-functional teams, agencies, franchisees and field partners.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in QSR, food and beverage, retail, CPG or another high-frequency consumer business.
* Experience delivering national campaigns in Canada and working within a franchise system.
* Experience across social, public relations, digital, CRM, loyalty, sponsorship or influencer marketing.
* Experience working with media, production and measurement partners to improve campaign effectiveness.

Title: Manager Marketing and Communications
Description:
St. Joseph's Health Centre Foundation is entering a defining chapter. As we accelerate into *Build Extraordinary* , a once-in-a-lifetime campaign to transform healthcare in Toronto's west end and beyond, we're seeking passionate, talented people to join our team.

For more than a century, St. Joe's has cared for our west-end community. Today, it is one of Canada's busiest community teaching hospitals, serving a vibrant and growing population of more than half a million people.

Reporting to the Vice-President Communications and Donor Engagement, the Manager, Marketing and Communications will play a key role in leading core pillars of marketing and communications, content planning, and execution across the Foundation, helping to drive public profile, a consistent, elevated brand experience, and *Build Extraordinary* awareness, interest, engagement, and investment across all channels.

This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to a bold vision while working alongside a collaborative team dedicated to shaping the future of community healthcare.

  

**RESPONSIBILITIES & ACTIVITIES**

**Marketing-Communications**

* + Lead content and narrative planning, execution, and measurement across multiple channels, including social media, email/enews, web, digital and in-hospital signage, impact reporting, etc., in collaboration with internal Foundation teams and external partners including hospital staff.
  + Lead and oversee the development of marketing and communications experiences and materials, event signage and collateral, impact reports and printing, including project managing the development of the Foundation’s annual impact report.
  + Develop, execute, manage, and evaluate in-hospital digital signage within the context of the Foundation’s broader content strategy and plan, in collaboration with Foundation staff and vendor.
  + Work with the VP Communications and Donor engagement and external agencies to brief, develop and launch marketing communications campaigns and related executions, including design, advertising, media buying, and digital to deliver on the intended objectives.
  + Oversee the design and production of materials for major projects, signature events, and campaigns, including photoshoots and the Foundation’s annual impact report, brochures, posters and signage, videos and all marketing collateral.
  + Oversee design and edits to the Foundation’s website and event microsites, ensuring a strong experience, timely updates, and overall desired website performance.
  + Build, lead and manage relationships with external vendors in the delivery of design, print, web, video, photography, etc and other services, reviewing samples, obtaining relevant approvals, testing and reviewing for quality assurance, and training direct reports on new system process.
  + Make recommendations based on insights derived from research and the evaluation of other sector activity.
  + Oversee and manage the tracking of budgets, vendor invoices and credit card payments.

* + Lead marketing and communications team project management, including task assignment, portfolio and workload management of team members, troubleshooting, as needed.

  + Lead team project tracking and weekly status reviews to ensure current and upcoming projects remain on track, and to manage priorities and tight deadlines.
  + Set-up, evaluate and streamline team processes, including use of project management sofware, identifying areas for growth or improvement.
