Title: Technical Architect – SAP S/4HANA, ABAP & BTP
Description:
### **Technical Problem Solver | Solution Navigator | Trusted Advisor**

**Location**: Remote

**Employment Type**: Full-Time

**Department**: Professional Services / Delivery

**Reports To**: Practice Director / VP Delivery

### **About the Role**

Bramasol is seeking an experienced SAP Technical Architect with strong expertise in SAP S/4HANA, ABAP, and SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) to help customers translate complex business challenges into practical, scalable, and sustainable SAP solutions.

The ideal candidate combines deep technical knowledge with business understanding, curiosity, sound judgment, and strong consulting skills. This individual understands not only how SAP technologies work, but when and why to apply them to achieve the best business outcomes.

This is a hands-on, client-facing technical leadership role focused on bridging business and technology. The Technical Architect will evaluate requirements, explore alternative approaches, and recommend appropriate solutions leveraging standard SAP functionality, ABAP development, SAP BTP services, integrations, extensions, automation, and emerging technologies.

We are looking for a natural problem solver who asks thoughtful questions, challenges assumptions constructively, and approaches complex challenges with a “let’s figure out how” mindset, rather than simply explaining why something cannot be done.

### **Key Responsibilities**

### **Business Understanding & Technical Problem Solving**

* Engage with business stakeholders and functional teams to understand business objectives, challenges, and underlying requirements.
* Ask thoughtful questions, challenge assumptions, and explore alternative approaches to solving business problems.
* Translate business requirements into practical SAP technical solution options, clearly communicating trade-offs, risks, costs, and long-term implications.
* Evaluate when to leverage standard SAP functionality, ABAP, SAP BTP, integrations, extensions, automation, or other technologies.
* Recommend solutions that balance business value, technical feasibility, implementation effort, and long-term maintainability.

### **Technical Architecture & Solution Design**

* Design scalable, secure, and supportable technical solutions across SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition, Public Edition, and hybrid landscapes.
* Apply SAP Clean Core principles when evaluating standard capabilities, ABAP Cloud, in-app and side-by-side extensibility, APIs, and integration approaches.
* Provide architectural guidance across SAP BTP services, including Integration Suite, API Management, and relevant development and automation capabilities.
* Evaluate technical dependencies, data flows, integration patterns, security considerations, performance requirements, and operational supportability.
* Lead technical discovery sessions, solution design workshops, and architecture reviews.
* Establish and promote technical standards, reusable patterns, and development best practices.

### **Technical Leadership & Delivery Accountability**

* Provide technical leadership across SAP implementations, migrations, integrations, enhancements, and transformation initiatives.
* Take ownership of technical architecture decisions and remain engaged throughout development, testing, deployment, and stabilization to ensure successful outcomes.
* Guide and mentor ABAP developers, integration specialists, BTP consultants, and other technical team members.
* Review technical designs, challenge proposed approaches, and assist in resolving complex technical issues.
* Collaborate with project managers, functional leads, and other architects to identify risks, manage dependencies, and drive decisions to closure.
* Proactively communicate technical concerns, recommend solutions, and follow through on commitments.

### **Customer Consulting & Collaboration**

* Build trusted customer relationships through technical credibility, clear communication, responsiveness, and a commitment to customer success.
* Translate complex technical concepts into understandable business language to support informed decision-making.
* Work collaboratively across functional and technical disciplines to develop solutions that address customer needs.
* Demonstrate ownership, professional judgment, and accountability when navigating challenging customer situations.
* Maintain a solutions-oriented approach, exploring possibilities and practical alternatives when faced with technical or business constraints.

### **Innovation & Business Development**

* Stay current with SAP S/4HANA, BTP, ABAP Cloud, RAP, Fiori, Integration Suite, and emerging SAP technologies.
* Identify opportunities to leverage automation, AI-enabled tools, and modern SAP capabilities to improve customer outcomes.
* Contribute to Bramasol’s technical knowledge, reusable solutions, accelerators, and delivery practices.
* Support pre-sales activities, including technical discovery, architecture discussions, solution estimates, and proposal development.

### **Required Qualifications & Experience**

* Extensive experience in SAP technical consulting, solution architecture, or technical leadership within complex enterprise environments.
* Strong foundation in SAP ABAP development, including object-oriented ABAP, enhancements, interfaces, APIs, and modern development approaches.
* Solid understanding of SAP S/4HANA architecture, extensibility, integration technologies, and technical design principles.
* Practical experience with SAP BTP and modern SAP integration approaches, particularly Integration Suite.
* Familiarity with SAP Clean Core principles, ABAP Cloud, RAP, CDS, OData, and SAP Fiori development approaches.
* Demonstrated experience defining technical solutions and guiding development teams through implementation.
* Ability to evaluate competing technical approaches and recommend solutions based on business value, architectural suitability, and long-term supportability.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Demonstrated accountability for technical decisions, delivery commitments, and successful customer outcomes.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Architecture experience across multiple full-lifecycle SAP S/4HANA implementations or transformation initiatives.
* Experience with SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition and/or Public Edition.
* Working knowledge of SAP Finance (FI/CO), Sales and Distribution (SD), or other enterprise business processes.
* Experience with event-driven architecture, API Management, SAP BTP extension services, and automation.
* Experience supporting technical pre-sales, solution estimation, and customer advisory engagements.
* SAP certifications in relevant S/4HANA, ABAP, BTP, or Integration Suite technologies.

### **What We’re Looking For**

**Beyond technical expertise, we value consultants who demonstrate:**

* **Curiosity**: A genuine desire to understand business challenges, ask meaningful questions, and explore new possibilities.
* **Ownership and accountability**: A willingness to take responsibility, identify risks early, and follow through until issues are resolved.
* **Collaboration**: The ability to work effectively with customers, functional consultants, developers, and other stakeholders.
* **Practical problem-solving**: The judgment to recognize constraints while finding creative, achievable ways forward.
* **Customer focus**: A commitment to responsiveness, clear communication, professionalism, and earning customer trust.
* **Continuous learning**: An interest in emerging technologies, evolving SAP capabilities, and improving how solutions are delivered.

### **The Ideal Candidate**

The ideal candidate is a business-oriented technical architect, natural problem solver, and trusted consultant who can move comfortably between business conversations, architectural decisions, and detailed technical discussions.

They understand the SAP technology ecosystem well enough to determine not simply how to build something, but whether it should be built, where it belongs, and which approach creates the greatest long-term value for the customer.

Most importantly, they combine technical expertise with curiosity, collaboration, sound judgment, and the accountability to see solutions through to successful delivery.

* Communicate effectively, verbally and in writing, and to prepare comprehensive report writing

* Exercise independent judgment in planning work details and in making technical determinations
Act in a professional manner at all times and maintain proper confidentiality as required

**JOB SPECIFIC FUNCTIONS**
--------------------------

**Essential Job Functions, Duties, Responsibilities, and Tasks**

* Customer Service and Operational Support
  + Provide professional and responsive assistance to employees, visitors, and the public
  + Provide information, directions, escorts, and other security-related customer services

* Security Patrol and Surveillance
  + Conduct routine and random patrols of buildings, parking areas, and other properties
  + Monitor CCTV, alarms, radios, and other security technology
  + Identify and report suspicious activity, safety hazards, policy violations, and maintenance concerns
  + Enforce organizational security policies and procedures

* Access Control and Facility Security
  + Control access to facilities by monitoring entrances, issuing visitor credentials, securing doors and gates, and responding to access control issues
  + Identify, investigate, document, and report security concerns and unauthorized activity

* Emergency Response and Life Safety
  + Respond to emergencies including medical incidents, fires, alarms, hazardous conditions, disturbances, workplace violence incidents, and natural disasters
  + Provide emergency medical care within certification level, including CPR, AED, and First Aid
  + Support continuity of operations and perform assigned duties during emergencies or disasters

* Incident Management and Coordination
  + Investigate, document, and report criminal acts, incidents, policy violations, safety hazards, and other security-related concerns

Incumbent is accountable for all duties of this job, and other projects and responsibilities may be added at the City’s discretion.

* Must be 21 years of age or older
* High school diploma or GED
* At least two (2) years of armed security experience
* No felony convictions
* Valid Colorado driver’s license
* Ability to obtain and maintain required qualifications and certifications
* Current CPR/AED and First Aid certification or ability to obtain within 90 days
* Ability to obtain and maintain required qualifications and certifications including a pre-employment firearms qualification

**Preferred:**
  

* Law enforcement or military experience
* Experience with enterprise access control, CCTV, visitor management, and alarm monitoring systems
* De-escalation and crisis intervention training
* Experience in municipal, healthcare, higher education, or corporate security

Any equivalent combination of education, training, and experience, which would provide the required knowledge and skills, may be considered.
  
**Physical Requirements:**
  
Work is sedentary in nature and requires sufficient physical stamina and strength for:
  

* Occasional use of sufficient physical strength, stamina, agility, and ability to capture, and control subjects or suspects, including those who may be bigger in stature and strength, resistive, combative, or attempting to elude custody
* Constant sitting to perform daily tasks; occasional walking through a multilevel facility to retrieve information; frequent standing, sometimes for extended periods
* Frequent squatting, reaching above shoulder, and twisting to; occasional bending, kneeling, climbing, balancing, and reaching below shoulder to store documents, material, and supplies
* Frequently sits, stands, walks, climbs stairs, bends, kneels, reaches, and occasionally runs

* Occasional lifting, carrying, and pushing and/or pulling of up to ten (10) pounds to move material and supplies; occasional lifting, pushing and/or pulling of up to 25 pounds with dollies and carts

Works indoors and outdoors in all weather conditions. Position requires rotating shifts, occasional weekends, and emergency call-back. May be exposed to hazardous situations, communicable diseases, traffic, and emotionally charged incidents. Exposure to periods of high activity and stress under demanding conditions. The position requires a great deal of communication with City employees, the public, and outside agencies.

Title: SRO, Customer Excellence.

You will set how AI agents and account teams work together, so that everyone who serves a customer works from the same, accurate picture.

Title: Legal Counsel
Description:
Echelon contracts continuously: a portfolio of technology partners on structural, programme and referral agreements, MOUs and term sheets with defence and energy technology companies, customer Scopes of Work delivered by our forward deployed teams, and a share plan that reaches every employee.

We are looking for a qualified hands-on lawyer — admitted to practice, with the training that comes with it — who has drafted and negotiated the contracts behind technology and AI delivery services, understands how those businesses work, and has the head for it: one who would rather be the only counsel in the room than one of twenty. The legal function grows next year; you will have shaped how it works before it does.

**THE ROLE: WHAT YOU WILL OWN**
-------------------------------

You will run the day-to-day legal work of the group: drafting, negotiating and closing under the group’s standards, keeping the corporate house in order, and working with the General Counsel and external counsel on the matters that need them. The growing part of that work is services contracting: Echelon sells the expertise and time of its engineers, and the master services agreements, Scopes of Work, rate cards, staffing and subcontracting agreements under which they are deployed are heavily negotiated contracts the group signs. You will draft them, negotiate them and close them. Under the Delegation of Authority the CEO is the only signatory, so the quality of what reaches his desk is the whole of the job. Partnerships with technology companies require a different discipline: referral, revenue-share and reseller agreements, IP boundaries and exclusivity terms that must protect Echelon’s margin and position over the life of the relationship, not only the length of one engagement.

You will carry files from first draft to signature, hold Echelon’s positions on exclusivity, margin protection and first right of refusal for our forward deployed teams, and decide what needs the General Counsel and what does not. The method exists; you own the outcome inside it and decide the sequencing and the trade-offs, so that most files close on standard paper and the exceptions get the attention they deserve.

* **Services contracting:** Master services agreements, Scopes of Work, rate cards, and staffing and subcontracting agreements for our engineering services business — with customers, with the partners we deploy for and with the firms we deploy alongside. Large, recurring contracts, often negotiated on the other side’s paper: you draft, negotiate and close them.
* **Partner & commercial contracting:** NDAs, MOUs, term sheets, referral and revenue-share agreements, from first draft to signature through the DoA signature process.
* **Templates & playbooks:** The recurring instruments — partner referral agreement, Partner Revenue Share terms, Scope of Work, NDA, employment contract and amendment — so that most files close on standard paper.
* **Corporate housekeeping:** Board and shareholder resolutions, registers, the shareholders’ agreement and the share plan documentation for the holding company and the Saudi operating company, with the GNRC.
* **Employment & regulatory:** Contracts, performance-bonus amendments, policies and Saudi labour-law compliance with the People function; the regulatory perimeter around data, licensing and, with Echelon Defense Industries, clearance-bound activity.

**WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR - WHERE WE ALIGN**
-------------------------------------------

A hands-on lawyer who reads fast, drafts clean and marks uncertainty rather than inventing a position. You find contracts interesting because of what they make possible, not because of what they prevent.

* **Curiosity:** You want to understand the deal before you paper it: where the value sits, what the partner actually wants, what the technology does. You hold the position that protects it.
* **Speed of learning:** An unfamiliar instrument — a share plan, a referral agreement, a defence MOU — comes back from you as a workable draft, not as a list of questions.
* **Ownership & pace:** A file is yours from first draft to signature. You turn a term sheet in days and keep the corporate record current without being asked.
* **Judgement:** Pragmatic on commercial points, immovable on the ones that matter. You escalate the right things and explain why in three sentences.
* **Where you are:** A qualified lawyer — a law degree and admission to practice are required — based in Saudi Arabia or the UAE, with hands-on experience of delivery-services contracting — Scopes of Work, master services and subcontracting agreements — and a working understanding of the technology and AI sector; fluent legal drafting in English, with Arabic spoken and written. What you have closed counts for more than how many years you have been closing.

**OUR VALUES**
--------------

* **Customer first:** You measure your work by customer outcomes, and prioritise accordingly.
* **Ownership mentality :**You own outcomes end to end. When something breaks or stalls, you treat it as yours to fix.
* **Clear communicator:** You explain complex systems simply, to operators and executives alike, and make the value of your work visible.
* **Comfortable with ambiguity:** You make progress with incomplete information, partial data and unfamiliar environments, and you enjoy solving problems where there is no structure yet.
* **Long-term builder:** You invest in Echelon’s long-term success, bringing field insight back into our strategy and operations.

**THE SEAT**
------------

**Location:** Riyadh, Saudi Arabia; open to candidates based in Saudi Arabia or the UAE  
**Languages:** English & Arabic fluent  
**Reporting:** Echelon CEO; dotted line to Echelon’s holding Legal Counsel department  
**Package:** A base salary with housing and education allowances, medical cover, and equity through the employee equity programme. Terms are shared at offer stage.

**HOW WE WORK**
---------------

You start from the problem, not the precedent. You meet an unclear brief or an unfamiliar instrument with energy and a plan.

* **Curiosity:** You learn how the business and its technology really work, and keep learning as the deals and the law move.
* **Speed:** You move from brief to workable draft quickly and do not wait for perfect conditions.
* **Rigour:** You check before you rely, read every clause you put forward for signature and can explain every position you take.
* **Confidence & humility:** You challenge and accept challenge, and change your view on evidence, without ego.
* **Autonomy:** You decide with incomplete information and own it; from an outcome, you organise the work yourself.
* **Resourcefulness:** Missing documents, partial facts, an unfamiliar jurisdiction: you find a way with what is available.
* **Situational leadership:** You lead when the moment calls for it, and follow when someone else has the better call.
* **A force multiplier:** Your templates, playbooks and clear guidance make every team you work with faster.
* **AI-native practice:** AI tools are part of how you research, draft and review, and you know where their output needs a lawyer’s check.

Title: Senior Cybersecurity Specialist - Saudi National
Description:
**Job Description**

The Cybersecurity Senior Specialist shall be responsible for the leadership, governance, assurance, and oversight of all cybersecurity activities. The role will ensure that cybersecurity requirements are defined, implemented, verified, and maintained throughout the project lifecycle, from design and procurement through testing, commissioning, handover and operations readiness.

The Cybersecurity Manager will provide strategic direction and management oversight across Information Technology (IT), Operational Technology (OT), railway control systems, communications systems, station systems and connected infrastructure to ensure cyber risks are identified, managed, and reduced to an acceptable level.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Cybersecurity Leadership**

* Develop and implement the project cybersecurity management strategy and cybersecurity assurance framework.
* Establish cybersecurity governance arrangements across all project stakeholders.
* Lead cybersecurity working groups, technical reviews and management reporting activities.
* Act as the primary cybersecurity focal point for the project.

**Regulatory and Stakeholder Management**

* Interface directly with RCRC regarding cybersecurity requirements, compliance activities and assurance reporting.
* Interface with the National Cybersecurity Authority (NCA) on matters relating to regulatory compliance and cybersecurity controls.
* Coordinate cybersecurity reviews with government agencies, Contractor, Metro Operators and other external stakeholders.
* Support cybersecurity audits, inspections, and regulatory assessments.

**Project Delivery Assurance**

* Ensure cybersecurity requirements are integrated into project requirements, specifications, contracts and supplier deliverables.
* Verify cybersecurity requirements are appropriately addressed throughout system design, implementation, testing and commissioning.
* Review and approve cybersecurity documentation produced by contractors and suppliers.
* Monitor implementation of cybersecurity measures across all project packages and disciplines.

**Risk Management**

* Establish and maintain the project Cybersecurity Risk Register.
* Identify, assess and manage cybersecurity threats and vulnerabilities affecting project systems and assets.
* Ensure cybersecurity risks are addressed through appropriate mitigation measures and assurance evidence.
* Support risk acceptance and management decision-making processes.

**System and Operational Technology Security**

* Provide cybersecurity oversight of the Contractor for railway signalling, telecommunications, control systems, SCADA, networking infrastructure, station systems and operational technology environments.
* Ensure the Contractor provides appropriate segregation, protection and monitoring of critical operational networks.
* Review the Contractor’s cybersecurity architecture and defence-in-depth strategies and propose guidance.
* Support secure integration between operational and enterprise systems.

**Assurance and Compliance**

* Oversee and guide Contractor’s cybersecurity assurance management activities across the project lifecycle.
* Oversee cybersecurity testing, vulnerability assessments, penetration testing and compliance verification activities with the Contractor.
* Ensure the Contractor develops quality cybersecurity case documentation and evidence required for project approvals.
* Support independent assessment and certification activities where required.

**Handover and Operational Readiness**

* Support the development of operational cybersecurity procedures and incident management arrangements.
* Ensure cybersecurity controls are fully implemented prior to system acceptance and handover.
* Coordinate cybersecurity readiness reviews for revenue service commencement.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, Information Technology or a related discipline.
* Master's Degree in Cybersecurity, Information Security, Engineering Management or a related discipline is highly desirable.
* Professional certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CRISC, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor, GICSP, IEC 62443 or equivalent are highly desirable.

**Experience Requirements**

* Minimum 20 years of professional experience in cybersecurity, systems assurance, critical infrastructure, rail, transportation or major infrastructure projects.
* Minimum 10 years in a senior leadership or management role.
* Demonstrable experience delivering cybersecurity programmes on large-scale complex transportation, rail, metro, aviation, defence, utility or other critical infrastructure projects.
* Experience interfacing with government authorities, regulators, and owner organisations.
* Experience managing cybersecurity requirements through design, implementation, testing, and commissioning phases.
* Experience working within multi-contractor and international project environments.
* Previous Middle East or Saudi Arabia project experience is highly desirable.

**Knowledge Requirements**

* Saudi National Cybersecurity Authority (NCA) frameworks, controls, and regulatory requirements.
* Cybersecurity risk management and assurance methodologies.
* Industrial Control Systems (ICS) and Operational Technology (OT) cybersecurity.
* Railway systems including signalling, communications, SCADA, AFC, PSDs and station systems.
* IEC 62443, ISO 27001, NIST Cybersecurity Framework and related standards.
* Cybersecurity governance, auditing and compliance management.

**Key Competencies**

* Strategic leadership and stakeholder management.
* Strong communication and influencing skills.
* Risk-based decision making.
* Regulatory engagement and compliance management.
* Technical understanding of critical infrastructure cybersecurity.
* Contract and supplier management.
* Report writing and executive-level communication.

**Security Clearance**

The successful candidate must be capable of obtaining and maintaining any project, client or governmental security clearances required for the execution of the role.

Title: eMBMS Engineer
Description:
**Grow with us**
----------------

**About this opportunity:**

The Back Office (BO) eMBMS Engineer supports the availability, performance, and service continuity of the LTE Broadcast / evolved Multimedia Broadcast Multicast Service platform used for mission-critical communications. The engineer owns second-line operational investigation and restoration of the Ericsson Mission Critical Broadcast Delivery Center (MC BDC) / Broadcast Core, and works across MCX application servers, LTE RAN, IP transport, cloud infrastructure, and network management teams to resolve end-to-end service issues.

This is an operations and service-assurance position, not sole ownership of RAN radio design, transport routing, MCX application logic, or cloud infrastructure. The engineer should understand those domains well enough to isolate faults, coordinate restoration, and validate outcomes.

**Join our Team**
-----------------

**Key Responsibilities**

**Service Assurance and Incident Management**

* Degree or equivalent practical experience in telecommunications, networking, computer engineering, or a related field.
* Hands-on experience supporting LTE/EPC or mission-critical communications platforms in a telecom operations / back-office environment, including incident, problem, and change management.
* Working knowledge of eMBMS/LTE Broadcast: MBMS sessions and bearers, MBSFN and service areas, SAI, TMGI, eNB/MCE, multicast versus unicast delivery, and synchronized radio transmission.
* Ability to trace control and user planes across MC AS, MC BDC, RAN, and transport; familiarity with Diameter, SCTP/M3AP, GTP-U/UDP, IP multicast, TCP/IP, routing, and time synchronization.
* Strong Linux troubleshooting skills, including logs, process/service checks, network diagnostics, and HA clustering; ability to use vendor OAM/CLI and performance counters safely.
* Clear technical communication, disciplined fault isolation, concise incident documentation, and willingness to participate in an on-call or shift rota if required by the service contract.

**Broadcast Core Operations**

* Operate and troubleshoot MDF-CP (provisioning and session control), MDF-UP (content ingestion, encoding/delivery and user plane), MDF-MH (M3 session handling), and MDF-DB (session persistence and recovery).
* Check Pacemaker/Corosync cluster health, resource placement, virtual IPs, database replication, node failover, and active/standby behavior; investigate HA and geographic failover with the MCX and infrastructure teams.
* Investigate stale or failed sessions and resource occupancy after path or site failures. Perform session restart, stop, cleanup, or failover actions only under an approved runbook/change or incident authority, with impact assessment and post-action validation.
* Maintain operational visibility of service-area configuration, SAI-to-cell/MBSFN mappings, MCX bearer parameters, interface connectivity, certificates, DNS/NTP, authorized network access, and capacity headroom; raise discrepancies to the configuration owner.

We’re searching for a detail-oriented and forward-thinking **Revenue Assurance and ITSM Specialist** to be located out of **Vancouver, Calgary, Edmonton or Toronto** supporting our **Head Office branch.**

The Revenue Assurance and ITSM Specialist plays a key role in ensuring financial integrity and operational excellence across the organization. This dual-focused role helps ensure that services delivered are accurately reflected in billing processes while driving continuous improvement across IT Service Management practices. You will work across key ITSM processes, including change, incident, problem, asset, and request management, helping strengthen service quality, maintain compliance, and improve operational efficiency. * Partner with the Client Experience and Operations teams to improve revenue visibility and reduce manual intervention
* Partner with the Practices and Service Owners to ensure billing and costing models are addressed as part of service realization or service iteration efforts
* Contribute to the ongoing optimization of ITIL-aligned processes including Incident, Change, Request, Problem, Knowledge and Asset Management
* Support documentation quality reviews, process standardization, and reporting improvements across SMO functions
* Identify opportunities for automation, simplification, and improved client-facing workflows within ITSM practices

* 3+ years' experience in IT Service Management, Business Operations, or Financial Governance in a managed services or IT environment
* Familiarity with managed services contract structures, SLAs
* Solid understanding of ITIL principles with minimum ITIL Practitioner certification
* Experience with service management tools (e.g., ServiceNow)
* Strong analytical skills with attention to detail and comfort working with spreadsheets and operational data
* Demonstrated ability to drive process improvement and cross-functional collaboration
* Excellent communication and problem-solving skills
* **Certified Associate Project Manager**
* Agile Hybrid Project Pro
* Familiarity with billing models
* Experience in revenue assurance, financial operations, or service delivery audits
* Proficiency with Power BI or other reporting tools

Description:

**Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for** ***all*****.**

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

As our Software AI Platform Services Engineer, you'll be a key part of keeping our AI platforms running reliably. You will help improve our operations by enhancing documentation and encouraging clear communication. You will identify recurring issues and trends and support the team in delivering reliable services that meet our SLA commitments.

  
  
  

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

* Provide support for enterprise platforms and services, including ServiceNow, Azure, Microsoft Power Platform, UiPath, APIs, Claude and Copilot integrations, and automation.
* Own incidents and service requests from triage through resolution. Stay accountable even when resolution needs other engineering teams, vendors, or domain experts.
* Diagnose complex issues across applications, integrations, infrastructure, authentication, configurations, and platform dependencies to find root causes and solutions. Use logs, monitoring and diagnostic tools, knowledge bases, documentation, and vendor resources to investigate independently.
* Give internal customers responsive, white-glove support with clear communication and timely updates.
* Manage work to established SLAs, priorities, and operational expectations. Proactively identify and call out risks.
* Work with engineering teams, platform owners, vendors, and other support teams to drive issues to resolution. Take part in incident management and handling customer concerns related to business-impacting issues.
* Document troubleshooting steps, solutions, and known issues. Help create and improve knowledge articles, runbooks, and operational procedures.
* Identify recurring incidents, support trends, and opportunities for automation, documentation, training, or process improvements that reduce repeat issues and improve reliability. Share technical knowledge and troubleshooting approaches with teammates.
  

  
  

**Minimum Qualifications:**
---------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field. 5+ years supporting and troubleshooting enterprise applications, integrations, automation platforms, or infrastructure systems.
* Experience triaging, troubleshooting, and resolving L2-L4 incidents and service requests in an ITSM platform such as ServiceNow. This includes working to SLAs and bringing up issues to engineering teams and vendors.
* Working knowledge of automation and AI-enabled tools used in IT environments, such as generative AI assistants, Power Platform, or UiPath.
* Working knowledge of APIs, system integrations, authentication, and cloud platforms such as Azure, enough to troubleshoot issues across them.
* Clear verbal and written communication with engineers and business collaborators, and effective collaboration with engineering teams and vendors.
  

  
  

**Preferred Qualifications:**
-----------------------------

* Experience with Event Management, AIOps, Discovery, CMDB, and Service Mapping. Certifications are a plus.
* Experience with LLM orchestration, agent frameworks, Model Context Protocol, retrieval-based solutions, and agent evaluation. This includes delivering ML, generative AI, or agentic AI solutions into production IT environments, ideally on major cloud AI platforms.
* Experience with enterprise monitoring tools such as Splunk, AppDynamics, Dynatrace, OpsRamp, or SAP Solution Manager. This covers event management, alert correlation, and integrating operational platforms with those tools.
* Familiarity with AI risk, governance, and responsible use of AI tools. Experience in semiconductor, manufacturing IT, or operational technology environments.
* Contributing to AIOps or IT operations improvement initiatives, mentoring teammates, and participating in process improvement and information exchange.

Title: Utilization Review
Description:
Position Summary

The Utilization Review (UR) Specialist manages the authorization lifecycle for patients receiving behavioral health and substance use disorder (SUD) treatment across MYMB's client facilities. This role secures initial authorizations, completes concurrent reviews, and advocates for medically necessary levels of care with commercial payers, managed care organizations, and government plans. The UR Specialist works closely with facility clinical teams, admissions, VOB, billing, and appeals to protect reimbursement and keep patients in the care they need.

Levels of Care Supported

* Medical detoxification / withdrawal management
* Residential treatment
* Inpatient psychiatric hospitalization
* Partial Hospitalization Program (PHP)
* Intensive Outpatient Program (IOP)
* Outpatient (OP) and psychiatric services
* Adolescent residential / academy programs

Essential Duties and Responsibilities Authorizations and Reviews

* Obtain pre-certification and initial authorizations for admissions, typically within 24–72 hours of admit or per payer requirements
* Conduct concurrent (continued-stay) reviews by phone, portal, or fax, presenting clinical information clearly and persuasively to payer care managers
* Request step-down authorizations as patients transition between levels of care (e.g., detox → residential → PHP → IOP)
* Track authorization numbers, approved dates/units, next review dates, and LOC changes in the EMR and UR tracking log
* Complete retrospective reviews when authorization was not obtained at admission

Clinical Documentation and Medical Necessity

* Review clinical records (assessments, psychiatric evaluations, nursing notes, progress notes, treatment plans, discharge plans) to build a strong medical necessity case
* Apply ASAM Criteria, InterQual, MCG, LOCUS/CALOCUS, and payer-specific guidelines to justify level of care
* Identify documentation gaps and communicate them promptly to clinical staff so records support the requested care
* Coordinate with facility physicians for peer-to-peer reviews and prepare case summaries in advance

Denials, Appeals, and Payer Communication

* Respond to adverse determinations by scheduling peer-to-peer reviews and initiating expedited or standard appeals within payer timelines
* Draft or assist with written UR appeal letters, and hand off post-service appeals to the Appeals team with complete documentation
* Maintain professional working relationships with payer UR representatives and case managers
* Escalate trends in denials, short authorizations, or payer behavior to UR leadership

Coordination and Reporting

* Communicate daily authorization status, last covered days (LCDs), and pending reviews to facility clinical directors, admissions, and billing
* Partner with VOB to confirm benefits, UR requirements, and payer contacts prior to admission
* Ensure authorization data matches claims to prevent billing denials
* Maintain daily, weekly, and monthly UR reports (census, auth status, denials, days approved vs. requested)
* Update UR task lists, spreadsheets, and EMR records (e.g., KIPU) accurately and on time

Compliance

* Maintain strict confidentiality under HIPAA and 42 CFR Part 2 (SUD records)
* Follow payer contracts, state regulations, and company policies on authorization and documentation
* Participate in audits and quality reviews as requested

Qualifications

* 2+ years of utilization review experience in behavioral health and/or substance use disorder treatment
* Working knowledge of ASAM Criteria and medical necessity standards for psychiatric and SUD levels of care
* Experience with commercial payers (e.g., BCBS/Anthem, Aetna, Cigna, UHC/Optum, Humana) and managed behavioral health organizations
* Strong clinical vocabulary: DSM-5 diagnoses, withdrawal symptoms/scales (CIWA, COWS), risk factors, and treatment interventions
* Excellent verbal advocacy and written communication skills
* Ability to manage a high-volume caseload across multiple facilities with competing deadlines
* Proficiency with EMRs, payer portals, Microsoft Excel/Outlook

Preferred

* Licensed clinician or clinical background (LPN, RN, LCSW, LPC, LMFT, CADC, CAC, or similar)
* Experience with KIPU, or comparable EMR/PM systems
* InterQual or MCG certification
* Experience with adolescent and inpatient psychiatric UR
* Familiarity with out-of-network billing, single case agreements, and payer appeals

Title: Physiotherapist
Description:
Physiotherapists treat patients with physical difficulties resulting from illness, injury, disability or ageing. They treat people of all ages including children, the elderly, stroke patients and people with sports injuries . They work with patients to identify and improve their movement and function. They help promote their patients' health and wellbeing and assist the rehabilitation process by developing and restoring body systems, in particular the neuromuscular, musculoskeletal, cardiovascular and respiratory systems. They devise and review treatment programs, comprising manual therapy, movement, therapeutically exercise and the application of technological equipment, e.g. IDD therapy. Physiotherapists also provide advice on how to prevent injury.

Title: H&S and Facilities Coordinator
Description:

Doha, QA

Company: Nord Anglia Education

**Location:** Compass International School, Doha, Qatar
  
**Reports to:** Operations Manager

**Job Purpose**

  

The H&S & Facilities Coordinator is responsible for the school’s health and safety arrangements, operation and maintenance of its buildings, grounds and infrastructure. The role ensures a safe, secure, compliant and well-maintained environment for students, staff, visitors and contractors. It supports the implementation of Nord Anglia Education (NAE) health and safety policies, school procedures and Qatar regulatory requirements, while promoting a proactive and positive safety culture.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

**Health & Safety**

* Manage and support the school’s health and safety management system, ensuring policies and procedures are understood and applied.
* Give practical health and safety advice to school leadership, operations, facilities, teaching and support staff.
* Coordinate and maintain risk assessments for activities, facilities, educational visits, events, contractors and higher-risk areas, and monitor control measures.
* Carry out regular site inspections (classrooms, laboratories, sports areas, playgrounds, facilities and transport areas), record findings and follow up actions.
* Ensure accidents, incidents, near misses and hazards are reported and investigated; identify root causes and recommend corrective and preventive actions.
* Use the school’s health and safety management system to track incidents, inspections, audits, risk assessments and outstanding actions.
* Support emergency preparedness, including fire evacuation, lockdown and medical emergency procedures, and coordinate drills and follow-up.
* Deliver or coordinate inductions, refresher training and awareness sessions, and maintain training records.
* Support internal and external audits, inspections and reviews.
  

**Facilities & Maintenance**

* Manage the day-to-day operation of the school estate, keeping facilities safe, functional and fit for purpose.
* Coordinate statutory inspections, testing and certification, and maintain compliance records.
* Manage contractors and service providers, ensuring work is safe, efficient and to the required quality standard, including reviewing documentation, inductions and monitoring on site.
* Maintain asset registers, equipment records and maintenance histories to support lifecycle planning.
* Provide facilities support for school events, examinations and emergency situations.
  

**Reporting & Continuous Improvement**

* Prepare regular health and safety and facilities reports for the Operations Manager, Principal and Regional Health & Safety Manager.
* Identify trends, recurring issues and opportunities to improve safety, maintenance and service delivery, and support school health and safety improvement plans.
  

**Key Relationships**

  

**Internal:** Principal and Senior Leadership Team; Operations Manager; Finance Team; Facilities and Maintenance Team; School Nurse / Medical Team; Teaching and Support Staff; Heads of Department; Security, Transport and Catering Teams

  

**Regional:** Regional Health & Safety Manager; Regional Operations Director

  

**External:** Contractors and service providers; parents and visitors where required; local authorities and regulatory bodies where required

  

**Qualifications and Experience**

  

**Essential**

* Relevant qualification in Occupational Health and Safety, such as the NEBOSH International General Certificate or equivalent, or equivalent experience.
* Degree, diploma or equivalent in Facilities Management, Engineering, Construction or a related discipline.
* Experience in a health and safety role, preferably within a school, education, facilities, hospitality, healthcare or similar operational environment.
* Experience managing facilities operations, maintenance programmes and contractors in a complex operational environment.
* Good understanding of risk assessment, inspections, incident investigation and corrective action management.
* Good understanding of building maintenance, statutory compliance and facilities management.
* Strong communication and organisational skills, and the ability to work with a wide range of stakeholders in a school environment.
* Good IT skills and the ability to maintain accurate records.
  

**Desirable**

* IOSH Managing Safely.
* First Aid or Fire Safety training.
* Certified Facility Manager (CFM), FMP or equivalent.
* Project management qualification (PMP, PRINCE2 or equivalent).
* Experience using health and safety management systems.
* Experience supporting audits, emergency drills and contractor safety.
* Experience in an education environment and/or in Qatar or the wider GCC.
  

**Personal Attributes**

  

The successful candidate will be proactive, organised, practical and solutions-focused. They will manage competing priorities, take ownership and build positive relationships with staff, students, contractors and leadership teams. They will stay calm under pressure and show attention to detail, sound judgement and integrity, with a commitment to a safe, healthy, compliant and well-presented school.

  

**Safeguarding**

  

Compass International School is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people. The successful candidate must comply with all safeguarding, child protection and safer recruitment requirements, including relevant background checks.

Title: Safety Engineer
Description:
Core Role and Responsibilities:

* Execute the Project HSE Plan, method statements, risk assessments (JSA/HAZID), and

COSHH controls; maintain evidence of competence and ensure resources for HSE are

adequate and sustained throughout the works

* Maintain all HSE documentation, including audit and inspection reports, and ensure

compliance with all KAHRAMAA and national HSE requirements.

* Participate in toolbox talks, safety briefings ,attend meetings, training sessions, and

workshops as required by KAHRAMAA.

* Enforce KAHRAMAA HSE rules at sites; support the HSE Manager/Coordinator in

developing the training matrix, audit/inspection plans, and coordination with KAHRAMAA on

HSE matters.

* Conduct site HSE inductions; lead toolbox talks; deliver/arrange topic-specific training

(Emergency Response & Preparedness, HAZMAT, Confined Space, Working at Height,

Lockout/Tagout, Electrical Safety, Lifting & Rigging, Power Tool Safety, Excavation Safety,

PPE, Waste Management, Incident Reporting & Investigation, Root Cause Analysis)

* Ensure appropriate PPE is issued, conforms to KAHRAMAA requirements, and is

inspected/maintained regularly (helmets, shoes, goggles/face shields, dust goggles, gloves,

harnesses/lifelines.)

* Maintain site housekeeping and safe storage/handling of materials, including

flammable/hazardous substances; implement controls for hot-work and welding areas with

suitable firefighting equipment.

* Keep portable firefighting equipment available on site from commencement to takeover;

ensure maintenance and mandatory weekly checks; recharge after use and manage stocks

of fresh charges; control open flames and flammable materials per KAHRAMAA instructions.

* Immediately notify KAHRAMAA of accidents/near misses; secure the site/witnesses; submit

Initial Incident Report and final investigation report as per KAHRAMAA guidelines.

Keep accident logs, patient/illness records, and periodic medical exam reporting as required

by national regulations referenced by KAHRAMAA.

* Execute planned audits/inspections; issue NCRs; drive corrective/preventive actions;

escalate unresolved hazards; exercise stop-work authority where necessary; track closure

and communicate changes to personnel

* Oversee electrical safety controls during installation, replacement, testing, commissioning,

and maintenance of LV and HV electricity meters and communication modules, including

working-at-height, energized work controls, lockout/tagout, and safe cabling/antenna

installation in poor-signal areas (subject to KAHRAMAA approval)

* Ensure use of dedicated communication signal strength analyzers (no mobile apps

permitted) when validating AMI communications; coordinate safe handling/transport/storage

of assets with KAHRAMAA access for inspection.

* Maintain daily/weekly/monthly safety reports, inspection logs, incident registers, training

records, and PPE registers; support project progress reporting cadence and WBS execution

phases (Engineering/Procurement/Execution/Close-out) with HSE inputs.

* Provide hard/soft copies of HSE documentation for audits and at KAHRAMAA’s request.

* Coordinate with KAHRAMAA HSE Department, line departments, customers, contractors,

and telecom providers for shutdowns, emergency works, and multi-site mobilization;

participate in emergency drills and ensure readiness of response teams.

* Maintain availability across three shifts in a 24×7 environment; travel between venues/depots

during and outside office hours for inspections, incident response, and verification of

corrective actions (as operationally required).

***Qualification & experience***

* Bachelor’s degree in Fire & Safety, Electrical, Mechanical, or Chemical Engineering (or

related discipline);

* KAHRAMAA-approved First Aid and Basic Fire Fighting certificates required; ISO

45001/14001 Lead Auditor, Risk Management (QRA/JSA/HAZID) training preferred.

* Demonstrated experience in Construction/Industrial Safety within utility/infrastructure

projects; ability to coordinate and manage HSE issues, conduct audits/incident

investigations, and apply applicable national/international HSE laws.

* Hands-on experience supporting metering roll-outs (including LV/HV Electricity meters) and

AMI field operations with safe methods of work and compliance to KAHRAMAA procedure.

Title: Contract and Billing Specialist - USA
Description:
**Who we are**

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

**About the role:**

Samsara's Customer Success team is on the front lines of business value delivery by helping customers adopt our platform, realize measurable business value, and renew and expand with confidence. Billing errors, concession requests, and cancellation or return exceptions currently land with CSMs, CS managers, and several partner teams, each holding part of the picture. As our customer base and billing complexity have grown, these cases take too long, repeat for the same reasons, and pull CSMs away from adoption and renewal work. As the Contract and Billing Resolution Specialist, you will be the single owner of complex billing and contract cases for Mid-Market and Commercial accounts.

You will take a customer's report that something is wrong with their bill, work out what happened across systems and teams, choose the right path to fix it, and see it through, keeping the customer informed. It is part detective, part project manager, part customer advocate. You will also tell the teams who own the underlying systems and processes what keeps breaking.

Your role will be cross-functional, working alongside and connecting Customer Success Managers, Sales, Billing Support, Order-to-Cash, Sales Ops, Deal Desk, Finance, and Legal. This is a new role, and you will help shape the case record, the root-cause tags, and the monthly read-out that define how Customer Success resolves billing and contract cases at Samsara.

**This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US except the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.**

**You should apply if:**

* **You want to impact the industries that run our world:** Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster.
* **You thrive the most when solving problems:** Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
* **You are a natural relationship builder:** Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
* **You are the architect of your own career:** If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
* **You want to be with the best:** At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

**In this role, you will:**

* Own complex billing and contract cases for Mid-Market and Commercial accounts, from the first report to a confirmed fix, and keep the customer informed in plain terms, including accounts that are delinquent or facing suspension.
* Reconstruct the full story behind a billing error across contracts, order forms, segment or ownership changes, reprocessing, and invoicing, including cases with several AE handoffs and no clean record of what was promised.
* Separate a correction of a Samsara error from a concession, a return, a reprocess, and a contract amendment, and choose the path that fixes the customer's billing, not only the immediate complaint.
* Drive Billing Support, Order-to-Cash, Sales Ops, Deal Desk, Finance, and Legal to execute the fix.
* Evaluate and prepare concession requests: confirm whether Samsara was at fault, size the request against policy and the approval matrix, write a short case summary (what happened, root cause, options considered and ruled out, recommendation, and risk), route it to the right approver, and confirm the credit is applied and the customer told.
* Support cancellation, return, and ETF exceptions: validate eligibility (purchase and renewal dates, trial history, Return ACV, financing partner, documentation), prepare the case for the approving team, act as the Customer Success fallback when the first approver does not respond within the window, and make sure approved outcomes are processed.
* Be the front door for billing, concession, and cancellation requests: log every request in a single case record, including those that arrive via Slack, email, or Gainsight; redirect them to the right path; and coach CSMs and AEs on what a complete request looks like.
* Fix repeat causes: tag the root cause on every case, separate one-offs from systemic failures, and deliver a monthly read-out to the teams that own the systems and processes involved.
* Carry forward the billing improvement work with Support, Finance, and Product, including earlier detection of billing problems that threaten renewals.
* Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's operating principles, including Keep a High Bar, Be Intellectually Honest, and Solve Problems Together, as we scale.

**Minimum requirements for the role:**

* 4+ years of experience in billing operations, order to cash, revenue operations, deal desk, contracts, or a similar finance and operations role.
* This is a demanding position with high internal visibility that requires strong priority management and high emotional intelligence.
* Strong investigative skills: you can rebuild a timeline from incomplete or conflicting information across CRM, billing, and contract systems, including when the people involved have left.
* Sound financial judgment about credits, concessions, reprocessing, and refunds, and a clear way of explaining your recommendation.
* Customer-facing communication that stays honest and composed in hard conversations, and written summaries a leader can read once and decide on.
* A record of driving results across teams without authority over them, including working to deadlines in an approval process.
* Familiarity with order forms, amendments, and terms, and how they flow into billing.
* Comfort with ambiguity and incomplete precedent, and rigorous case management so nothing drops across weeks and stakeholders.
* Diplomacy, tact, and poise under pressure when working through customer issues.

**An ideal candidate also has:**

* Experience handling escalated or high-dollar billing disputes.
* Experience with Salesforce, NetSuite, or an equivalent ERP, and CPQ tools. We also use Zendesk, Gainsight, and Sweethawk.
* Customer Success, Support, or account management background with customer-facing financial or contract work.
* Experience building or improving billing dispute processes.
* Exposure to subscription or hardware-plus-subscription billing.
* AI First: Experience using AI tooling to drive efficiency and outcomes.
* Strong bias for action and insistence on high standards

**Total Rewards**

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

**Flexible Working**

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

**Belonging at Samsara**

Title: AI Enablement Engineer
Description:
Requisition ID: 278493
  
  
Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture.

  

Scotiabank continues to be an industry leader for Payment’s technology and innovation. We have a history of safely leveraging new tools to enable new experiences for our customers, focusing on ensuring we protect their interests and goals. The result of this leads to modernization programs which aim to offer enriched information and transparencies to support the rapidly evolving payments community.

  

**The Role**

As an AI Enablement Engineer, you will serve as the crucial bridge between our enterprise Artificial Intelligence platforms and our workforce. You will drive the adoption, effective utilization, and value realization of generative AI and intelligent productivity tools across the organization.

This is a highly strategic and user-centric role. You will not be responsible for coding, model training, or backend engineering. Instead, your focus will be on human-centric AI adoption: ensuring our teams know how to use these technologies, understand their evolving capabilities, and integrate them seamlessly into their daily workflows to maximize business value.

  

**What You’ll Do:**

  

User Onboarding & Adoption

* Design and execute comprehensive onboarding programs to introduce employees to enterprise AI tools.
* Develop user guides, technical manuals, and structured documentation to support system usage and knowledge transfer.
* Develop role-specific use cases and quick-start guides to help new users overcome initial learning curves.
* Partner with department heads to identify specific workflows that can benefit from AI integration.
* Analyze and create business workflows to improve efficiency and align them with new technology adoption initiatives.
* Lead structured information gathering sessions with stakeholders to identify business needs and opportunities for AI-driven workflow improvements.

  

Capabilities Roadmap & Strategy

* Monitor the evolving landscape of enterprise AI platforms and stay informed on upcoming feature releases.
* Translate vendor roadmaps into internal, business-focused capability roadmaps.
* Assess how new features align with business objectives and communicate these updates to the wider organization.

  

User Training & Education

* Create and deliver engaging training sessions, workshops, and webinars tailored to various technical proficiency levels.
* Develop best-practice resources, such as advanced prompt engineering libraries and functional workflow templates.
* Establish and manage a community of "AI Champions" across different departments to foster peer-to-peer learning.
* Support end-to-end platform delivery by ensuring users are equipped to adopt new tools through structured enablement and guided usage practices.
* Support the delivery and rollout of new platforms, ensuring smooth transition from implementation to user adoption.

  

User Support & Feedback Loop

* Serve as the primary functional point of contact for user questions, best-practice inquiries, and workflow troubleshooting.
* Triage technical bugs or system outages to the core technical engineering/IT teams.
* Gather, synthesize, and advocate for user feedback to shape future AI rollouts and training initiatives.
* Continuously improve workflows and user experience based on feedback gathered during post-implementation support.
* Perform functional validation and testing to ensure solutions align with business requirements and deliver expected user outcomes.

  

Value Realization & Metrics

* Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) related to AI adoption, active usage, and user sentiment.
* Conduct surveys and interviews to measure time saved, productivity gains, and overall ROI of AI initiatives.
* Identify, document, and share internal success stories to drive continued engagement and demonstrate tangible business value.

  

**What You'll Bring:**

* 7+ years of progressive experience in software engineering, technology delivery, architecture, digital transformation, AI enablement or a related technology discipline.
* Experience leading complex technology initiatives across cross-functional teams.
* Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle, Agile delivery and modern engineering practices.
* Practical experience applying Generative AI or AI-assisted technologies to software engineering, testing, automation or technology operations.
* Understanding of LLMs, Generative AI and emerging AI capabilities, with the ability to translate them into practical technology solutions.
* Experience moving technology initiatives from discovery or proof of concept into implementation and adoption.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to work across Engineering, Architecture, Business, Risk and other groups.
* Strong continuous-improvement mindset with demonstrated ability to coach teams and drive adoption of new technology.
* Post-secondary education in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems or a related discipline.

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* **Experience:** Proven experience in technology enablement, change management, customer success, or digital transformation roles.
* **Tech Fluency:** Strong conceptual understanding of Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), and enterprise productivity suites. No coding or backend development experience is required.
* **Adaptability:** Highly agile and capable of quickly learning new software platforms as our AI toolset evolves.
* **Communication:** Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technological concepts into simple, business-friendly language.
* **Empathy:** A user-first mindset with a strong ability to understand and address the frustrations, fears, or hurdles employees face when adopting disruptive technologies.
* **Analytical:** Ability to track metrics, interpret data adoption, and build reports demonstrating business impact.
* 5-7 years of experience working in a similar capacity as a BA/BSA
* Bachelor’s degree in business analytics, Information sciences or another related field
* Fluency in Spanish (Nice to Have).
* Experience defining and measuring productivity and operational benefits from AI.

  

**What's in it for you?**

This role offers exposure to a wide range of technologies, problem domains, and stakeholders.

Title: ELV & Starlink Installation Technician
Description:
**About Starway Link**

Starway Link is a UAE telecom and infrastructure company headquartered in Deira, Dubai. We install Starlink satellite dish antennas for business customers as a Starlink installation subcontractor, and deliver ELV (Extra Low Voltage) systems for offices, retail outlets and commercial buildings. Starway Link is a SIRA-approved contractor for CCTV supply and installation.

**Role Summary**

We are looking for a hands-on installation technician to carry out Starlink satellite installations and ELV works at customer sites. The technician will survey sites, install and terminate equipment, configure and test systems, hand over to the customer, and complete all job documentation (work order completion forms, photos and test records). The role needs someone who is safe working at height, neat with cabling, comfortable dealing with customers, and able to work independently on site.

**Key Responsibilities**

***Starlink Installation***

* Conduct site surveys using the Starlink app to check for a clear sky view, obstructions and the best mounting position.
* Install Starlink dishes on roofs, walls, poles and parapets using the correct mounts (pole, wall, pivot, non-penetrating ridgeline or ballast).
* Route, protect and seal outdoor cables; drill and seal wall penetrations properly to prevent water ingress.
* Install and configure the Starlink router, power supply and, where required, Ethernet adapters, mesh units or third-party routers and switches.
* Activate and test the service: signal, speed test, Wi-Fi coverage and connected devices. Explain basic use to the customer.
* Complete the work order completion form and before/after photos for each job and get the customer's sign-off.
* Attend service calls for relocation, obstruction issues, cable faults and equipment replacement.

***ELV Systems***

* **CCTV:** Install IP cameras, NVRs, PoE switches and monitors; configure recording, remote viewing (mobile app) and user accounts. Follow SIRA requirements for camera coverage, recording retention and documentation.
* **Structured cabling:** Pull, terminate and label Cat6/Cat6A cables; install patch panels, racks and cabinets; test and certify links.
* **Containment:** Planning for GI conduits, trunking, cable trays and back boxes as per site requirement.
* **Network & Wi-Fi:** Install and configure switches, routers and access points.
* **Audio / BGM / paging:** Install speakers, amplifiers and volume/zone controls; test and balance audio.
* **Access control & intercom:** Install readers, electric locks, exit buttons, controllers and video intercoms; enrol users and test.
* Read and work from layout drawings and BOQs; mark up as-built changes.
* Carry out preventive and corrective maintenance on existing ELV systems.

***Site Survey & Documentation***

* Survey sites before quotation: count existing equipment, check what can be reused, measure cable runs and note access issues.
* Share survey findings and material lists with the team for quotations.
* Keep records of serial numbers, MAC addresses, IP addresses and passwords of installed devices and update the company device register.
* Prepare test reports, handover documents and as-built notes.

***Safety & Site Conduct***

* Follow site HSE rules, building management rules and permit-to-work requirements (mall, tower and landlord permits).
* Use PPE and work-at-height equipment (harness, ladders, scaffold) correctly.
* Keep tools, materials and company vehicle (if assigned) in good condition; report stock used on each job.
* Leave every site clean and tidy after work.

***Customer Service***

* Behave professionally with customers, building security and facility managers.
* Explain the completed work and basic operation to the customer at handover.
* Report customer requests or upsell opportunities (internet, SIM, PBX, CCTV upgrades) to the sales team.

**Requirements**

***Qualifications & Experience***

* Diploma / ITI / technical certificate in Electronics, Electrical, Telecom or Networking.
* 2–4 years' experience in ELV installation (CCTV, structured cabling, networking); UAE / GCC experience preferred.
* Experience with outdoor installations is a strong advantage.
* Valid UAE driving licence preferred.

***Technical Skills***

* CCTV brands such as Dahua and Hikvision.
* Cat6 termination, punch-down, crimping, cable testing and labelling.
* Basic networking: IP addressing, DHCP, PoE, VLANs, Wi-Fi configuration.
* Use of hand and power tools: drills, hammer drill, crimpers, testers, ladders.
* Ability to read layout drawings and simple single-line diagrams.
* Basic computer and smartphone use for apps, reports and photos.

***Personal Skills***

* Safe and confident working at height and outdoors in UAE weather.
* Neat, organised workmanship.
* Good communication in English.
* Punctual, reliable and able to work independently or in a team.
* Flexible to work evenings, weekends or outside office hours when sites require it.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Jobs completed on time and right first time (no repeat visits).
* Complete job documentation submitted the same day (completion form, photos, test results).
* Zero safety incidents.
* Customer satisfaction and sign-off on handover.
* Accurate material usage and stock reporting.

**Salary**

* To be decided in interview
