**PURPOSE OF JOB CLASS (NATURE OF WORK)**
-----------------------------------------

In a state agency this class is accountable for providing supervision and direction of a clinical unit.

**EXAMPLES OF DUTIES**
----------------------

* Schedules, assigns and oversees work of staff;
* Assists in developing unit goals and objectives;
* Assists in recruitment, selection, training and development of staff;
* Conducts performance evaluations;
* Determines priorities and plans, coordinates and supervises unit activities;
* Develops relationships with and acts as liaison to other operating units, agencies and outside officials, community representatives and customers;
* Assists in mediating conflict impacting on service recipients;
* Assists in ensuring staff ability to access and employ community resources;
* Assists in integrating community resources into service planning and delivery;
* Identifies barriers and assists in developing strategies and solutions for improving client care;
* Prepares reports; may assist in developing performance standards;
* May prospectively review and monitor client care for clients to determine clinical necessity and effectiveness of care;
* May educate providers on principles of managed care and its impact on client care;
* May perform clinical direct care duties as needed;
* Performs other related duties.

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILL AND ABILITY**
--------------------------------

* Considerable knowledge of
  + relevant agency policies and procedures;
  + mental health treatment, principles and values of community based care;
  + psychiatric rehabilitation principles;
  + entitlement and benefit programs;
  + variety of intervention and support strategies;
* Knowledge of
  + relevant state and federal laws, statutes and regulations;
  + societal, cultural and gender issues and impact on mental illness;
  + psychotropic medications;
  + impact of housing and homelessness on the mentally ill;
* Considerable
  + interpersonal skills;
  + oral and written communications skills;
  + facilitation, collaboration and conflict resolution skills;
* Ability to
  + identify and articulate philosophical foundations for specific program models or service approaches;
  + delegate authority;
  + plan and organize effectively;
  + integrate community resources into service planning;
  + develop and maintain effective relationships with community representatives and staff;
* Supervisory ability.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS - GENERAL EXPERIENCE**
-----------------------------------------------

Seven (7) years of professional health care experience in a psychiatric setting.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS - SPECIAL EXPERIENCE**
-----------------------------------------------

Two (2) years of the General Experience must have been at a lead level responsible for coordinating the work of a unit or team of professionals in a psychiatric setting.

NOTE: For state employees this experience is interpreted at the level of an Advanced Clinical Social Worker for social work discipline, Head Nurse for the nursing discipline, an Advanced Professional Counselor and an Advanced Marital and Family Therapist.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS - SUBSTITUTIONS ALLOWED**
--------------------------------------------------

* College training may be substituted for the General Experience on the basis of fifteen (15) semester hours equalling one-half (1/2) year of experience to a maximum of four (4) years for a Bachelor's degree.
* A Master's Degree in a health care field related to one of the disciplines in the Special Experience may be substituted for one (1) additional year of the General Experience.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience collaborating with multidisciplinary treatment teams, including psychiatric, nursing, and community-based providers
* Experience supervising, mentoring, and evaluating clinical staff
* Experience providing clinical services within an inpatient psychiatric or behavioral health setting
* Experience working with individuals with serious mental illness and complex psychosocial needs across the lifespan
* Experience managing competing priorities and responding effectively to rapidly changing clinical needs in a fast-paced environment
* Experience conducting clinical assessments, developing treatment recommendations, and facilitating communication among patients, families, treatment teams, and community providers

**SPECIAL REQUIREMENTS**
------------------------

* Incumbents in this class must possess and retain a current license as a Clinical Social Worker, a licensed Marital and Family Therapist, a licensed Professional Counselor, a Registered Nurse in the State of Connecticut or hold a Multistate or Compact Registered Nurse license. The license required for direct supervision of clinical oversight will be dictated by the functions of the assigned unit or program.
* Incumbents in this class may be required to possess certification as a clinical supervisor by the Connecticut Certification Board.
* Incumbents in this class may be required to be bilingual or fluent in American Sign Language.
* Incumbents in this class may be required to travel.

**WORKING CONDITIONS**
----------------------

Incumbents in this class may be required to lift and restrain clients, may have significant exposure to communicable and/or infectious diseases and risk of injury and may be exposed to strongly disagreeable conditions.

Title: Chief of Support Services
Description:
Job Responsibilities
  
  
The South Carolina Legislative Services Agency (LSA) is seeking an experienced and strategic Chief of Support Services Manager to lead and oversee all service-oriented operations supporting the South Carolina General Assembly. This position provides executive-level leadership support services including service desk, media support, legislative process, and information management and training, all within a non-partisan and apolitical environment.
  
  
The Chief of Support Services Manager is accountable for ensuring exceptional customer service delivery across all support services by providing reliable, intuitive, and secure technology and operational support. This role is responsible for reducing service friction, improving user experience, and ensuring that service outcomes are measurable, transparent, and aligned with legislative business needs.
  
  
The Chief of Support Services Manager serves as a trusted advisor to agency leadership and plays a critical role in aligning service delivery and operational planning with the mission and strategic goals of LSA. This role blends leadership, operational oversight, business analysis, and will work closely with project management to ensure high-quality, efficient, and innovative support services for the House of Representatives, Senate, and Legislative Council.
  
  
**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**

* Provide executive leadership and strategic oversight for all support services departments, ensuring streamlined, reliable, and responsive operations.
* Serve as the senior authority for service management initiatives, guiding planning, prioritization, and execution of operational and technology-related services.
* Act as a trusted advisor to the Agency Director on service delivery, operational effectiveness, organizational readiness, and change management.
* Lead and manage cross-functional teams, fostering collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Conduct comprehensive business, workflow, and service function analyses, including needs assessments and change impact evaluations.
* Define, recommend, and implement operational and service improvements using best-practice business processes and methodologies.
* Collaborate with the Senior Project Management lead for major agency initiatives, overseeing scope, schedules, risks, dependencies, and reporting to executive leadership.
* Lead the planning and implementation of special initiatives to support legislative bodies as they adapt to new technologies, methodologies, and lifecycle replacements.
* Develop and maintain operational documentation, service frameworks, performance metrics, and improvement workflows.
* Partner with division and team managers to identify current and future projects, resource needs, and service priorities.
* Promote a culture of professionalism, service excellence, innovation, and accountability across all support services functions.
* Ensure all activities support the mission of LSA in a non-political, non-partisan, and behind-the-scenes capacity.

**Customer Service Delivery & Excellence**

* Ensure support services operate with a customer-first mindset, delivering reliable, intuitive, and secure services that meet the needs of legislative staff and stakeholders.
* Drive continuous improvement in user experience by reducing service friction, improving response times, and proactively addressing recurring issues.
* Translate technical and operational decisions into clear business value that users can understand and experience.
* Own major service incidents and escalations end-to-end, ensuring timely communication, resolution, and post-incident review to prevent repeat occurrences.
* Serve as a visible, calm, and credible leader during service disruptions, setting expectations and communicating status, impacts, and resolutions in clear, non-technical language.
* Define, implement, and monitor service level agreements (SLAs), key performance indicators (KPIs), and performance dashboards to measure service reliability, responsiveness, and quality.
* Balance speed, quality, security, and compliance when delivering services and making operational decisions.
* Collect and analyze user feedback, service trends, and performance data to proactively improve services before issues escalate.
* Champion automation, self-service tools, and process improvements that enhance efficiency while maintaining service quality.

**Management & Leadership Responsibilities**

* Build, mentor, and retain high-performing service-oriented teams with a strong emphasis on professionalism, accountability, and customer service excellence.
* Coach staff in both technical competencies and soft skills, including communication, empathy, and stakeholder engagement.
* Establish clear roles, ownership, escalation paths, and accountability across support services teams.
* Act as the final escalation point for vendors and third-party partners, ensuring service commitments and performance expectations are met.

Manage service-related budgets and resources responsibly, justifying expenditures through demonstrated service outcomes
  
  
**Minimum And Additional Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in business management, computer science, information management, or another IT or business-related field.
* Minimum of five (5) years of progressive experience in:

+ IT business analysis
+ Project or program management
+ Personnel or team leadership

**Additional Requirements**

* Extensive knowledge of business analysis techniques, needs assessments, and change management principles.
* Strong leadership and personnel management skills with the ability to inspire, mentor, and develop teams.
* Advanced support services skills with the ability to independently drive initiatives from concept through completion.
* Exceptional planning, facilitation, communication, interpersonal, and influencing skills.
* Ability to understand both high-level strategic objectives and detailed operational requirements.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and conflict management skills.
* Proficiency in SharePoint, Microsoft Office, and IT support services methodologies, with demonstrated adaptability and a willingness to learn and support emerging AI technologies and models as the agency evolves.
* Excellent written communication skills for executive reporting, technical documentation, and professional correspondence.
* Excellent verbal communication skills with a professional appearance and demeanor.
* Ability to logically analyze complex problems and develop practical, sustainable solutions.
* Ability to set priorities based on the unique needs of the House, Senate, and Legislative Council.
* Must be personable, polite, respectful, flexible, open-minded, and non-judgmental.
* Must be comfortable working in a non-political, behind-the-scenes support role.
* Strong customer service orientation with the ability to balance user expectations, operational constraints, and organizational priorities.
* Proven ability to explain complex technical or operational issues in plain language to non-technical stakeholders.
* Demonstrated experience managing incidents, escalations, and service recovery in high-visibility environments.
* Ability to make decisive, accountable decisions under pressure while maintaining professionalism and trust.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* ITIL Foundation Certification (must be certified within a year of hire)
* Lean Six Sigma Certification (Green belt or higher).
* Experience working in a legislative, judicial, or government agency environment.

Experience establishing or improving
**service metrics, SLAs, KPIs, and performance dashboards**
Additional Comments
  
  
This is an onsite position operating within a professional government environment supporting the South Carolina General Assembly. The role requires frequent collaboration with executive leadership, technical teams, and service-oriented departments while maintaining strict non-partisanship and political neutrality. The work is mission-driven, service-focused, and essential to effective legislative operations. Success in this role requires a customer-first mindset, strong decision-making under pressure, clear and consistent communication, accountability and empathy for both service users and staff.
  
  
**Benefits For State Employees**
The state of South Carolina offers eligible employees generous benefits, including health and dental insurance; retirement and savings plan options; and paid vacation and sick leave. Plus, work-life balance programs such as telecommuting and flexible work schedules are available to employees of some state agencies.
  
  
**Insurance Benefits**
Eligible employees may enroll in health insurance, which includes prescription coverage and wellness benefits. Other available insurance benefits include dental, vision, term life insurance, long term disability and flexible spending accounts for health and child care expenses.
  
  
**Retirement Benefits**
State employees are also offered retirement plan options, including defined benefit and defined contribution plans. Additionally, eligible employees may elect to participate in the South Carolina Deferred Compensation Program, which is a voluntary, supplemental retirement savings plan offering 401(k) and 457 plan options.
  
  
**Workplace Benefits**
State employees may also be eligible for other benefits, including tuition assistance; holiday, annual and sick leave; and discounts on purchases, travel and more.
  
  
**Note:**
The benefits above are available to most state employees, with the exception of those in temporary positions. Employees in temporary grant and time-limited positions may be eligible for all, some or none of these benefits as benefits are associated with each position type. For these positions, contact the hiring agency to determine what benefits may be available.

Title: Professional Patrol - Supervisor
Description:
Overview:

The Summit at Snoqualmie is the Pacific Northwest's premier multi mountain ski resort, located 47 miles east of Seattle at Snoqualmie Pass. The property spans five base areas and 20 chairlifts across Summit West, Summit Central, Summit East, and Alpental within the Mt. Baker-Snoqualmie National Forest. A four-season operating model includes a mountain bike park and one of the most accessible ski destinations in North America.

The Summit at Snoqualmie is proud to be part of the Boyne Resorts family of resorts. Boyne Resorts is the largest family owned, independent mountain resort company in North America, guided by five core values: Serve First, Developing Great People, Attitude is Everything, Long Term Thinking, and Excellence in Execution.

Responsibilities:

**Long Term Thinking**

* Coordinate with the Patrol Managers and Patrol Director to ensure shared vision and goal alignment across the patrol team.
* Plan and/or coordinate training in conjunction with the Training Manager.
* Lead post-incident hot washes and support critical incident stress management (CISM) debriefs, ensuring psychological safety and confidentiality, identifying contributing factors and lessons learned, and communicating corrective actions to improve future response and risk management.
* Document incidents, near misses, and corrective actions in accordance with ski area policy, and apply organizational, local, and national safety standards to patrol operations.
* Plan for night operations, including lighting considerations, closure practices, night rescue resources and staff training, and when to activate Search and Rescue (SAR).

**Excellence in Execution**

* Assign duties, tasks, and projects as needed, and ensure their completion.
* Manage terrain openings and closings in conjunction with other patrol leadership.
* Attend assigned meetings.
* Work towards completing supervisor task book and personal professional development.
* Complete daily administrative paperwork, including the Daily Ops Sheet (key personnel for the day) and Daily Brief (key events and groups, weather and snow safety report, Forecaster on Duty check-in, carryover projects, training of the day, and safety notes).
* Lead beginning- and end-of-shift briefings covering current weather, snow, and avalanche conditions, the daily operational plan (openings, closures, and hazard zones), task assignments, and safety and emergency procedures, ensuring all patrollers sign in and acknowledge the briefing.
* Submit an end-of-shift overview to Teams for handoff and leadership awareness, and ensure in-shift training is properly documented and stored.
* Complete and verify patrol timekeeping in UKG in line with company policy on sick, overtime, and vacation time.
* Manage day-to-night shift change handoffs and tasking with patrol and other departments.
* Follow the Manager on Duty (MOD) process, recognizing when to raise issues up the chain and providing complete handoff information.
* Establish base area command during major incidents, following the Summit chain of command and notification structure and delegating tasks and resources appropriately.
* Know and carry out base area-specific operations, such as Nordic coordination; night terrain closures, terrain park opening committees, and tubing operations; snowmaking coordination and medical storage access; and upper mountain sweeps, night shift handoff, and avalanche hazard-based terrain openings and closings with the Snow Safety Team.

**Attitude is Everything**

* Ensure patrollers adhere to all corporate, Summit, and department policies and procedures, taking appropriate corrective action when needed.
* Be a leader in safety culture and maintain a focus on safety every shift.
* Promote a proactive, mindful, and constructive working environment.
* Conduct daily hazard assessments, implement patrol-level risk management protocols (weather, avalanche, lift operations, and guest safety), and exercise supervisory judgment to stop or modify operations when unsafe conditions or events exist.
* Uphold the Patrol Brand Standard Audit (BSA) every day, holding self and staff accountable, and model Boyne LEADS values and WOW service (Welcoming Spirit, Own Every Moment, Willing Attitude) with staff and guests.
* Apply de-escalation principles in guest interactions and enforce resort policies, including the Skier Responsibility Code, Park Safe, uphill travel, terrain closures, and the Employee Handbook, with proper documentation, disciplinary action, and pass revocation follow-up.

**Develop Great People**

* Coordinate with Volunteer Ski Patrol leadership.
* Maintain the knowledge, skills, and abilities to operate within — and train others on — patrol duties.
* Willing and able to complete routine employee coaching and check ins, beginning and end of season reviews, and create professional development pathways for patrollers.
* Maintain familiarity with all patroller task books (Apprentice, Senior, and Supervisor) and map individual progression pathways based on noted skills, desired skills, and natural aptitude, using internal opportunities and outside training such as avalanche, rope rescue, risk management, and OEC to EMT courses.
* Issue Notices of Expectations when repeat behavior continues or point-in-time coaching is unsuccessful, reviewing with managers, processing in conjunction with HR, and scheduling and documenting follow-up.

**Serve First**

* Communicate and work in conjunction with other departments to ensure efficient and safe operations for your team.
* Know the patrol leadership team, base area supervisors, department heads, and VPs, and choose the appropriate communication avenue (email, phone, or in person) for each situation.
* Maintain working knowledge of patrol programs and their points of contact, including Medical, Snow Safety, Risk, Training, Patroller Wellness, Transportation (UTVs), Supplies, and Toboggans.
* Support patroller wellbeing by knowing employee resources (mental health, financial hardship, and benefits) and the Patroller Care binder, and by managing on-the-job injury (OTJI) reporting and the workers' compensation process.
* Process guest pass and rental refunds and paperwork requests

Qualifications:

**Required**

* Positive season reviews from your previous two operating seasons.
* Advanced skier or snowboarder.
* Physically capable of hiking in rough mountain terrain and adverse weather while carrying skis and a 20–30 pound pack daily (occasionally 60+ pounds).
* Demonstrated ability to be observant and think critically about your environment.
* Proven ability to work both independently and as part of a team.
* Basic computer skills, including familiarity with Microsoft Office/Suite.
* Ability to pass a background check.

**EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE**

* Have completed at least four full winter seasons as a paid Experienced level ski patroller and/or be deemed qualified by the Patrol Director
* Medical skills: National or Washington EMT Basic, or Outdoor Emergency Care NSP Certification, and Annual BLS Provider CPR Certification

Title: Overnight Jet Vac Operator - Jet Vac
Description:
**JOB TITLE:** Overnight Jet Vac Operator (CDL-B) – Full-Time
  
**LOCATION:** Tampa, FL
  
**HOURS:** Flexible availability required. Work hours may vary between day and overnight shifts depending on customer needs.
  
**COMPENSATION:** $28-30/ Hour - Eligible for First Pay Increase at 6 Months
  
**TRAVEL:** Moderate (26-50%)​
  
  
**Who we are:**  
Sweeping Corporation of America (SCA) is the nation’s leading street sweeping company, operating in over 20 states and supporting more than 600 municipalities, counties, and government agencies. With over six million miles serviced annually, SCA is uniquely focused on the delivery of high-performance street sweeping, jet-vac, and environmental services. SCA has built its entire organization, its people, processes, technology, and investments around providing uninterrupted, accountable, and results-driven services tailored to the needs of our clients. Our mission is to provide essential sweeping and environmental services that support cleaner, safer, and more sustainable communities.
  
  
**Your daily impact:**  
As our next Jet Vac Operator, you'll be at the heart of our mission—delivering essential services that help improve public safety and enhance environmental quality. In this role, you'll take ownership of assigned routes, safely operate a Jet Vac truck and specialized vacuum equipment, and perform cleaning of storm drains, catch basins, culverts, and other drainage systems to help prevent flooding and keep our communities running smoothly.
  
The job responsibilities below outline the core duties and expectations of a position, providing clarity on how the role supports Company goals. However, not all duties can be listed, and as business needs evolve, responsibilities may shift over time to reflect new priorities, processes, or technologies:
  

* Safety & Inspection: Perform required pre-trip and post-trip inspections of equipment in accordance with company standards. Ensure all safety features are operational before beginning route.
* Execution: Review assigned routes thoroughly prior to departure. Be proactive in asking clarifying questions if the route or expectations are unclear. Complete assigned jobs within the allotted timeframe while maintaining expected quality and attention to detail.
* Equipment Operation: Operate equipment safely and efficiently at all times, following all traffic laws, company safety procedures, and site-specific protocols. Exercise additional caution during inclement weather or challenging site conditions.
* Material Handling: Handle materials safely and securely; Apply correct procedures for material types and disposal sites.
* Reporting: Report any equipment issues, malfunctions, near misses, crashes, or injuries within 30 minutes or as soon as safely possible. Immediately escalate opportunities, work issues, or safety concerns to management.
* Professional Communication: Maintain a professional attitude and appearance while representing the company on job sites or in public areas. Communicate effectively with team members, supervisors, and clients when needed.
* Compliance & Documentation: Accurately complete required logs, manifests, and forms.
* Adaptability & Problem Solving: Respond appropriately to changes and challenges; identify and solve issues timely.
* Regular & Predictable Attendance: The ability to consistently report to work on time and as scheduled, with minimal unexcused absences. This includes being present and prepared to work throughout assigned shifts, and reliably adhering to start times, breaks, and end times.

**Minimum Job Requirements:**  
Minimum job qualifications define the essential skills, experience, and abilities needed to succeed in the role. They set the baseline for hiring but may evolve as the job and business requirements change:
  

* Education: High School or GED
* Experience: 1 year DOT driving experience – waste & recycling services experience preferred
* License: CDL-B & DOT Medical Card
* Endorsements: Tanker
* Age: Must be at least 21 years of age
* Compliance: Must maintain an acceptable driving record and successfully pass a motor vehicle record (MVR) check, background check, and drug screening in accordance with Company policy and applicable law.

**Skills & Competencies:**  
Skills and competencies define the abilities and behaviors essential for success in the role. They guide performance expectations and may evolve as the role, team, or business priorities change:
  

* Safety & Compliance Focus: Ability to follow safety procedures, conduct inspections, operate equipment responsibly, and comply with all traffic, site, and regulatory requirements.
* Operational Execution & Reliability: Strong ability to plan routes, complete work efficiently and accurately, adapt to changing conditions, and maintain consistent, dependable attendance.
* Communication & Issue Reporting: Effectively communicate with supervisors and teammates, represent the Company professionally, and promptly report equipment issues, incidents, or safety concerns.

**Safety is #1:**  
Our safety culture is more than a policy—it’s a mindset. We have a full-time safety team, rigorous training programs, and detailed operating procedures to protect our people and the communities we serve. You’ll be supported from Day One with the tools and knowledge to work confidently and safely.
  
  
**Benefits & Wellness at SCA:**  
We believe great people deserve great perks. When you join SCA, you’re not just keeping the streets clean—you’re paving the way to a better future (with some solid benefits under the hood).
  
  
**Here’s what we’ve got in our hopper:**  

* 401(k) with Match: Plan for the long haul—retirement is another kind of clean sweep.
* Weekly Pay: Consistent weekly pay you can count on, plus on-demand pay so you can access earned wages when you need them.
* Health, Dental, Vision & Life Insurance: Take care of what matters most with benefits designed to support you and your family’s wellbeing and future.
* Short- & Long-Term Disability: If life throws a pothole your way, we help you keep rolling.
* Indemnity Insurance: Extra protection for life’s unexpected detours.
* Paid Time Off & Holidays: Even the best machines need downtime.
* Training Programs: Shift into high gear with learning and career advancement opportunities.
* Team Focus: We show up for our customers and each other, every day.
* A Culture that Cares: People are the heart of everything we do, fostering a culture of respect, safety, and growth
* Rooted in Respect: A company with a name people know & trust - built on relationships, community pride and a people focused approach to leadership.

**Physical Requirements:**  
Physical requirements outline the essential on-the-job demands needed to perform the role safely and effectively.
  

* Work Environment & Exposure: Constant work outdoors with regular exposure to weather, elements, and traffic; occasional exposure to loud noise, dust/debris, and jarring conditions; limited exposure to chemicals.
* Physical Demands: Frequent sitting and walking/standing; occasional bending, twisting, squatting, kneeling, pushing/pulling; limited stair climbing and crawling; ability to lift and carry up to 50 lbs at varying heights, including overhead.
* Cognitive & Sensory Requirements: Continuous reading, screen use, mental focus, and hand-eye coordination throughout the workday.
* Equipment & Tools: Operation of specialized equipment (e.g., mechanical broom sweeper) and use of hand controls, foot controls, and fine motor skills.
* Safety & Protective Gear: Required use of appropriate PPE, including high-visibility apparel, eye, ear, hand, foot, head, lung, and skin protection.

Title: Chief Operating Officer
Description:
Syntys is a leading digital infrastructure platform specializing in the design, development, and operation of carrier-neutral data centers across the Middle East and North Africa (MENA). With an established and expanding network of facilities across strategic markets, Syntys delivers secure, resilient, and scalable infrastructure for hyperscalers, AI clusters, and wholesale colocation providers. Through purpose-built facilities and build-to-suit solutions, Syntys supports the growing demand for cloud, AI, and advanced computing infrastructure, enabling the continued growth of the digital economy.

We are seeking a seasoned and results-driven
**Chief Operating Officer (COO)**
to provide strategic and executive leadership across our data center operations, with enterprise-wide accountability for operational excellence, mission-critical infrastructure availability, reliability, resilience, scalability, customer commitments, and service delivery.

Reporting directly to the CEO, the COO will play a pivotal role in translating Syntys’ ambitious growth strategy into scalable operational capabilities, building a high-performing organization, and ensuring the safe, reliable, and efficient operation of our data center platform.

The role encompasses executive leadership and oversight of Data Center Operations, Critical Mechanical & Electrical (M&E) Infrastructure, Network Operations Center (NOC), Facilities Management, Physical Security, Information Technology (IT), Cybersecurity, and Operational Sustainability, ensuring integrated governance, operational resilience, and consistent performance across all markets.

The COO will be instrumental in enabling business growth and delivering world-class operational standards to meet the demanding requirements of hyperscale cloud providers, AI infrastructure customers, GPU-intensive computing environments, and wholesale colocation clients.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* **Enterprise Operations & Strategic Leadership:**
  Develop and execute the enterprise-wide operations strategy, establishing scalable, standardized, and performance-driven operating models across all markets and facilities.
* **Mission-Critical Infrastructure & Engineering Operations:**
  Oversee mission-critical electrical, mechanical, cooling, power, fire protection, and facilities infrastructure, ensuring availability, reliability, uptime, and maintenance excellence. Ensure commissioning acceptance, integrated systems testing, and seamless transition from construction and project delivery into live operations.
* **Hyperscale & AI Infrastructure:**
  Drive operational readiness for hyperscale cloud, AI training, AI inference, and high-performance computing environments, including high-density power requirements, GPU infrastructure, advanced liquid cooling technologies, large-scale customer deployments, and phased capacity activation.
* **Executive Oversight of Operational Functions:**
  Provide executive oversight across headquarters and market operations, Critical Facilities Operations (Mechanical & Electrical), Network Operations Center (NOC), Facilities Management (FM), Physical Security, Information Technology (IT), Cybersecurity, and Operational Sustainability.
* **Operational Governance, Risk & Compliance:**
  Establish operational governance frameworks, policies, procedures, and controls across all facilities. Oversee incident management, root cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions, business continuity, disaster recovery, emergency response, crisis management, operational audits, risk assessments, regulatory compliance, Operational Technology (OT) Security, cybersecurity resilience, and third-party operator and contractor performance. Ensure adherence to applicable industry standards and data center frameworks, including Uptime Institute Tier standards and relevant ISO standards.
* **Customer Experience & Strategic Account Management:**
  Ensure delivery against contractual obligations, Service Level Agreements (SLAs), Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), and customer-specific requirements. Act as the senior executive escalation point for major operational incidents and customer concerns. Lead operational business reviews and support commercial growth through operational assurance and executive-level customer engagement.
* **Financial Performance, Asset Management & Sustainability:**
  Own operational expenditure (OPEX) performance and contribute to capital expenditure (CAPEX) planning and investment prioritization. Drive cost optimization, asset lifecycle management, operational productivity, procurement effectiveness, vendor performance, budgeting, and financial forecasting. Lead energy efficiency, carbon reduction, resource optimization, and sustainability initiatives, including Power Usage Effectiveness (PUE) and Water Usage Effectiveness (WUE).
* **Leadership, Organization & Talent Development:**
  Build and lead high-performing operations teams, establish clear organizational structures and leadership accountability, and drive succession planning, talent development, retention, and performance management. Foster a culture of ownership, operational discipline, safety, customer focus, engineering excellence, and continuous improvement.

**EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Facilities Engineering, Computer Engineering, or another relevant technical discipline. A Master's degree or relevant professional certifications are advantageous.
* **Minimum 20 years of relevant professional experience**
  , including significant senior leadership experience in data center operations, mission-critical infrastructure, or critical facilities environments.
* Proven track record of leading
  **large-scale, multi-site or geographically distributed data center operations**
  , preferably at COO, SVP Operations, or equivalent senior leadership level.
* Solid experience managing
  **hyperscaler, cloud service provider, and strategic customer relationships**
  , with a strong understanding of contractual commitments, SLAs, and service delivery expectations.
* Strong technical expertise in
  **mission-critical electrical and mechanical infrastructure**
  , including power systems, cooling technologies, maintenance strategies, operational reliability, and resilience.
* Demonstrated experience overseeing key operational functions, including
  **Data Center Operations, Network Operations Center (NOC), Facilities Management, Physical Security, IT, and Cybersecurity**
  , with the ability to lead multidisciplinary teams and manage operational interdependencies.
* Proven ability to manage
  **operational risks, critical incidents, business continuity, and crisis situations**

Title: Transport Coordinator
Description:
##### **Job Purpose**

Join our Transport Services team, where you will play a key role in managing and optimizing our fleet and transportation operations. The team is responsible for ensuring safe, efficient, and on-time performance through quality control, route management, transport assessments, and continuous improvements our transportation standards.

If you are passionate about logistics, operational efficiency, and upholding the highest health and safety standards, we invite you to apply and contribute to the success of Emirates Group. As part of the world’s largest international airline, our transport services team is essential in keeping our operations running smoothly and efficiently every day.

As a **Transport Coordinator** , you will be responsible for creating, updating, and maintaining vehicle records in CSTMS (Central Service Transport Management System) throughout the entire vehicle lifecycle, from inception to disposal, ensuring data accuracy and compliance with all system requirements. Generate reports and maintain comprehensive records of vehicle-related costs, monitor expenditures, reconcile pending issues, and ensure timely resolution of discrepancies. Coordinate application upgrades and system enhancements in line with operational requirements to improve efficiency. Liaise with vehicle users to identify and assess repair requirements based on reported non-technical information, conduct preliminary assessments, and assist senior management in establishing higher repair standards by recommending effective and economical solutions. Ensure efficient coordination of vehicle maintenance and repairs while maintaining cost control and optimal fleet performance.

**In this role, you will:**

* Maintain accurate and comprehensive vehicle records in CSTMS (Central Service Transport Management System) from inception to disposal. Records include vehicle specifications, user details, registration, insurance, and fuel card information. Exercise utmost care when entering technical data, as certain information cannot be amended once entered.
* Arrange repair appointments, prepare Repair Request Forms (RRFs) using appropriate technical terminology, coordinate drivers for vehicle delivery, and arrange collection upon completion of repairs. Ensure effective scheduling to minimise delays and allow sufficient time for repairs.
* Assist in inspecting vehicles and identifying technical faults within the Central Services fleet. Interpret reported problems from users who may lack technical knowledge and translate them into accurate automotive terminology to facilitate effective repairs while saving time and costs.
* Liaise with workshops to ensure accurate, timely, and cost-effective repairs. Obtain repair estimates and approvals from user departments, communicate approvals to workshops, follow up on repair progress, and ensure all relevant transactions are updated in CSTMS.
* Ensure timely collection and accurate uploading of workshop and agency invoices into CSTMS. Coordinate with IT and workshops to resolve data errors during invoice downloads, ensuring complete reconciliation with corresponding RRFs. Manually process invoices received from agencies and other garages on an invoice-by-invoice basis.
* Coordinate with internal departments regarding vehicle registration renewals, Traffic Department repair recommendations, accident-related repairs, and settlement of fines. Liaise with insurance companies, tyre suppliers, and EPPCO for insurance-related matters, tyre requirements, and fuel card issuance or cancellation.
* Assist senior management in preparing exception reports, analysing data, preparing case notes, and communicating findings. Monitor registration renewals, fuel card issuance, quotations, invoice verification, and CSTMS records to prevent overcharging and ensure cost-effective repairs and quality workmanship.
* Maintain comprehensive records of vehicle servicing, registration, insurance documents, invoices, accident reports, and other vehicle-related correspondence. Ensure timely communication of company vehicle user details to HR, Management Accounts, and Payroll.
* Provide technical guidance to user departments and workshops, as required, to ensure repairs meet the required standards. Advise vehicle users on appropriate vehicle care following major repairs, including engine and air-conditioning system overhauls.
* Prepare vehicle handover and takeover checklists, conduct random inspections of the Central Services fleet, and prepare snag lists. In the absence of available resources, arrange or personally undertake vehicle delivery and collection to and from workshops or senior managers' residences, as required.

##### **Qualification**

**To be considered for the role, you must meet the below requirements:**

* Have completed 12 years of schooling or equivalent.
Have at least 5 years of experience working in Supply Chain, Logistics or Transport.  

  

**You will have an edge if you have:**

* Have experience working with Resource Management Systems (RMS), Real-Time Control (RTC), Multi-Access Check-in System.
* Have experience working with Microsoft Office Applications.

With more than 60 years of experience, Toronto and Region Conservation Authority (TRCA) is one of 36 Conservation Authorities in Ontario, created to safeguard and enhance the health and well-being of watershed communities through the protection and restoration of the natural environment and the ecological services the environment provides.
  
  
TRCA is considered the provincial leader in conserving, restoring, and managing natural resources to advance safe and sustainable development. Also, TRCA was recently recognized as a Greater Toronto’s Top Employer for 2026 and a Canada’s Greenest Employer for 2026.
  
  
To apply to this posting, click on the “Apply” icon. Please submit your resume and cover letter in one file (PDF or Word) and upload using only the ‘Resume’ feature within the application prior to 11:59 pm on December 1, 2026.
  
  
**How you will contribute as part of the TRCA team:**  
The Education Interpreter delivers hands-on environmental and nature programs to visitors and visitor groups at Tommy Thompson Park. The Education Interpreter also conducts daily park inspections and assists with visitor emergencies, and plays an active role in customer experience ensuring all visitors have a positive experience. The Education Interpreter is comfortable working in a small team, under minimal supervision. Education Interpreters typically work in teams of two on weekends (Saturday and Sunday and holidays, 9 a.m. to 6 p.m./4:30 p.m. (summer/winter)) every other weekend, however, the schedule is flexible and based on staff availability. This is an occasional contract position in the environmental field.
  
  
**Major Responsibilities:**  

* Engages with the public and delivers hands-on interpretation of Tommy Thompson Park history, wildlife, habitats and restoration work. Ensures visitors are well-informed about how to use the park responsibly to maintain public health and safety.
* Greets visitors to the park, communicating permitted activities and trail etiquette.
* Conducts site inspections to identify any major hazards, incidents and issues.
* Addresses injuries and incidents at the park.
* Learns program content to be able to effectively deliver interactive programs to various audiences.
* Ensures program equipment/supplies including artifacts are well maintained, clean and stored appropriately.
* Provides support in program development and administrative tasks as required.
* Incumbents may also be assigned other duties.

**What will you need to succeed:**  
Education (degree/diploma/certifications/licenses)
  

* Minimum pursuing a post-secondary diploma or degree in a related field
* Valid Standard First Aid & CPR/AED Level C Certification
* Valid Ontario Class G2 driver's license

Knowledge/Skill/Ability - Competencies
  

* Understanding of Tommy Thompson Park and the area’s flora and fauna.
* Ability to deliver programs/information to audiences of various ages, adapting style to ensure audience appropriateness.
* Ability to communicate effectively with tact and courtesy.
* Experience interacting and connecting with persons of various social, cultural, or economic backgrounds; at ease with a variety of audiences.
* Strong communication skills to provide clear and concise communication in both non-emergency and emergency situations.
* Able to self-manage workload and prioritize tasks independently.
* Demonstrates responsiveness to internal and external customer requests and needs.
* Able to comprehend written documentation and procedural guidelines.
* Must be flexible to work all required shifts, including weekends and holidays.

Title: Client Consulting Analyst
Description:
**About Us**  
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

Overview:

Visa Consulting and Analytics (VCA) is the consulting arm of Visa and drives tangible, impactful results for clients. Drawing on our expertise in consulting, data analytics, technology, payments and economics, VCA solves the most strategic problems for our clients. The core client segments of VCA include issuers, acquirers, merchants, fintechs, payment enablers and governments.

Role Summary:

The Analyst for Digital, Strategy and AI supports the delivery of digital transformation, strategy and artificial intelligence (AI) engagements across the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) region.

  

The Digital, Strategy and AI Consulting practice is a team of experts specializing in strategy and digital transformation topics, including but not limited to:

Strategy:

* Defining business, segment, channel and functional strategies, such as digital banking, affluent banking, loyalty, open finance, stablecoins and artificial intelligence.

Ideation:

* Supporting the innovation agenda of clients through foresight, strategic trends research and co-creation activities.

Value proposition design:

* Developing holistic offerings, including products, services and customer experience, for strategic consumer, business and corporate customer segments.

Customer experience and engagement:

* Developing best-in-class digital customer journeys and engagement strategies, including digital onboarding, end-to-end digital journey transformation, digital channel benchmarking and user interface and user experience enhancement.

Performance analytics:

* Improving client performance and process efficiency by deploying data, digital and AI tools.

Digital delivery:

* Supporting clients with the implementation of digital strategies, including the design and development of digital channels, generative AI (GenAI) use cases and proofs of concept.

Key Responsibilities:

* As an Analyst, you will work within project teams under the guidance of senior consultants and managers, contributing to research, analysis and the development of client deliverables.
* Support the delivery of digital, strategy and AI projects across the GCC, from scoping through to final recommendations.
* Conduct market, competitor and customer research, including benchmarking and trends analysis, to inform client recommendations.
* Gather, clean and analyze data from Visa and industry sources to generate insights that support client recommendations.
* Contribute to the problem-solving process, including structuring analytical frameworks and developing insight-driven recommendations.
* Build business cases and financial models that measure business performance and quantify return on investment (ROI).
* Prepare clear and compelling client presentations and reports that communicate findings and recommendations.
* Support the preparation and running of client workshops and stakeholder sessions, and document findings, decisions and next steps.
* Track project workplans and deliverables, and keep the project leadership informed of progress, risks and issues.
* Collaborate with Visa Account Executives and the Product, Value-Added Services (VAS), Marketing and other internal teams to deliver integrated solutions as One Visa.
* Contribute to proposals and responses to requests for proposal (RFPs), as well as practice thought leadership, points of view and case studies.
* Help build reusable toolkits, templates and best practice documents that can be applied across the VCA practice.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

**Qualifications**

Basic Qualifications:

* At least 2 years of work experience in management consulting, preferably on financial services, payments, digital or AI projects.
* Degree from a leading university, preferably in business, economics, engineering, computer science or a related field.
* Professional proficiency in English.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel, including building clear and compelling presentations, financial models and data analyses.
* Strong curiosity about AI, including GenAI and agentic AI, with hands-on experience using AI tools for research, analysis or content creation and an understanding of how to use them responsibly.

Preferred Qualifications:

* Experience working on projects in the GCC region.
* Exposure to digital transformation, strategy or digital banking projects.
* Knowledge of banking products, services, operations; payment schemes, services, card issuing and marketing initiatives.
* Strong interest in fintech and payments.
* Proficiency in Arabic is a plus.

What You Will Need to Be Successful:

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure complex problems and work with large data sets.
* Strong storytelling skills, with the ability to turn analysis into clear and compelling presentations.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills.
* Commercial awareness and an understanding of the financial indicators used to measure business performance.
* A collaborative, diplomatic and flexible working style, with the ability to work effectively in a matrixed organization.
* High attention to detail and a commitment to deliverables quality.
* Self-motivated and results-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines at the same time.
* Curiosity and a willingness to learn, take on feedback and develop new skills quickly.
* Ability to build strong working relationships with clients and colleagues.

Title: Customer Delivery Software Architect
Description:
**About The Role**
Cisco Customer Experience (CX) is seeking a Customer Delivery Software Architect to lead the design and delivery of automation and AI-enabled solutions for a major service provider in Saudi Arabia.
  
  
You will define scalable software architectures that connect network infrastructure, operational systems, data platforms, and business workflows. Working with customer stakeholders and cross-functional Cisco teams, you will translate complex operational needs into secure, reusable, and maintainable solutions.
  
  
This is a software architecture role—not a network migration or product implementation role. Its primary focus is establishing sound architecture, engineering practices, integration patterns, and governance for network automation and intelligent operations.
  
  
Frequent onsite collaboration in Riyadh is required due to customer access controls, local testing requirements, and the need to work closely with engineering and operations teams.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Own the end-to-end software architecture for network automation, orchestration, assurance, observability, and AI-enabled operational solutions.
* Translate business and operational requirements into architecture blueprints, technical roadmaps, integration patterns, data models, APIs, and engineering backlogs.
* Design secure, modular, scalable solutions integrating network platforms with systems such as Cisco Crosswork.
* Establish engineering standards covering source control, automated testing, CI/CD, observability, documentation, release management, security, and software lifecycle governance.
* Guide engineering teams through solution design and delivery, conducting architecture reviews and ensuring implementations meet functional and non-functional requirements.
* Leads and influences global, cross-functional teams—including PMs, PgMs, SDMs, CEs, TLs, and customer stakeholders—to ensure successful delivery of complex, multi-architecture solutions aligned to business outcomes
* Define practical approaches for applying AI and analytics to use cases such as anomaly detection, operational insight, decision support, and workflow automation.
* Build reusable frameworks, reference architectures, and best practices while mentoring engineers and strengthening software architecture capabilities across delivery teams.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree with 12 or more years of relevant experience; master’s degree with 8 or more years; PhD with 5 or more years; or equivalent relevant work experience.
* Extensive experience designing and delivering enterprise-grade software, automation, orchestration, or systems-integration solutions.
* Strong proficiency in software architecture principles, distributed systems, API design, event-driven architectures, data modelling, and integration patterns.

The Enterprise Data team is responsible for supporting and modernizing the data platforms that enable analytics, artificial intelligence, customer engagement, strategic planning, and other enterprise capabilities across GM.

This role will help establish the engineering standards, reusable platform capabilities, delivery automation, and operational practices required for a secure, scalable, governed, and reliable cloud data ecosystem.

The ideal candidate combines strong business analysis and stakeholder engagement skills with experience in enterprise data environments and complex technology change. They are comfortable working across business stakeholders, data engineering, software, governance, and data quality teams to clarify needs, manage requirements and delivery processes, and help lead large-scale migration work while supporting the continuity of existing data services.

**The Role**

  

As a Business Analyst, Enterprise Data & Cloud Migration, you will serve as a primary interface between stakeholders across GM Canada and the internal data, software, governance, and data quality teams. You will translate business needs into clear requirements, delivery priorities, processes, and documentation that enable teams to maintain the existing enterprise data environment and deliver its migration to a cloud-based implementation.

This role combines business analysis, delivery coordination, and change management responsibilities. You will manage requirements and documentation, support process definition and improvement, facilitate sprint planning and backlog activities, and coordinate stakeholders through complex, interdependent work. You will play a critical role in migration planning and execution, helping teams assess impacts, manage dependencies and risks, validate outcomes, and maintain business continuity. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams, timelines, and priorities.  

**Preferred Qualifications**

Title: Global Security Operations Centre Operator
Description:
**About the role**
------------------

**International SOS is currently looking to hire a Global Security Operations Centre Operator in Doha, Qatar.**

An Operator is an integral member of the Global Security Operations Centre (GSOC). Under the direction and guidance of the GSOC Manager and GSOC Supervisor, the GSOC Operator will be tasked with the delivery of high-quality security risk monitoring, advice and the coordination of security assistance services on a profile and itinerary-specific basis to travellers, international assignees, domestic nationals, and QatarEnergy risk managers.

The GSOC Operator will contribute to operational readiness by carrying out tasking to maintain and develop the security provider network and internal Concepts of Operations.

The GSOC Operator is responsible for providing the delivery of professional and effective security assistance services to QatarEnergy to the highest standards of excellence and will also be tasked with intelligence collection, processing, and analysis to provide timely security assessments and advice to QatarEnergy’s Security Team and internal stakeholders, through primarily, but not exclusively, written reports, as required.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Core Support to QatarEnergy**

  

* Deliver high-quality, bespoke, verbal and written security risk assessments tailored to a QatarEnergy Business and Operations profile and itinerary, escalating to the GSOC Supervisor as required.
* Under the guidance of the GSOC Supervisor, coordinate and oversee responses to security requests for assistance, including the production of Plans of Action (POA) for specific Requests for Assistance (RFAs), as required.
* Set up, coordinate and monitor tracking tasks using GPS and communication with clients travelling in complex working environments.
* Contribute to operational readiness by supporting the maintenance and development of the security provider network and internal Concepts of Operations.
* Deliver professional and effective security assistance services to QatarEnergy, ensuring the highest standards of quality and service.

### 

### **Global Threat Monitoring**

  

* Conduct continuous monitoring of global security environments and risk indicators.
* Track geopolitical developments, terrorism, civil unrest, natural hazards and other emerging threats.
* Collect, process and analyse intelligence to support timely security assessments and reporting.
* Escalate identified threats in accordance with established SOPs and guidance from supervisors.

### 

### **Travel Security Risk Management**

  

* Provide support to pre-travel security requirements, including responding to traveller queries and delivering itinerary-specific advice.
* Monitor live travel movements of personnel and maintain situational awareness.
* Coordinate with approved security and medical assistance providers to facilitate support.
* Track and document incidents involving travellers, ensuring accurate reporting and timely updates.

### 

### **Crisis & Emergency Management Support**

  

* Support GSOC monitoring activities during incidents, crises and emergencies.
* Log, update and maintain accurate incident records and case documentation.
* Assist in information dissemination to relevant stakeholders as directed.
* Ensure proper case handover between shifts, maintaining continuity of operations.

**Required Skills & Knowledge**
-------------------------------

* Strong knowledge of the political and security landscape within QatarEnergy’s Region of Operations.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex situations to non-expert audiences in English.
* Ability to critically analyse multiple streams of information under time pressure.
* Demonstrated experience in the application of risk assessments.
* Strong IT skills, including Microsoft Office Suite and other applications.

**Required Work Experience**
----------------------------

* Typically, 1 to 3 years of experience in security intelligence or related fields such as military, government, NGO, journalism; relevant academic studies.
* Independent travel experience to multiple countries, including more challenging risk environments.

  ###
* ### **Preferred Experience**

  + Risk and Crisis Management experience.
  + Experience in writing to senior management and decision-makers.
  + International work experience, including in more challenging risk environments.
  + Experience of working in a customer/client-focused role.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Educated to a degree level (or relevant professional training) in a field related to security, risk management, international politics or international relations.
* Master’s degree in similar fields an advantage.

**Required Languages**
----------------------

* Excellent spoken and written English language.
* Other language (Arabic, French, etc.) proficiency desirable.

Title: Global Security Operations Centre Supervisor
Description:
**About the role**
------------------

**International SOS is currently looking to hire a Global Security Operations Centre Supervisor in Doha, Qatar.**

A prominent member of the GSOC, the Supervisor will act as a go-to-person for the Security Operator and will report to the GSOC Manager.

The GSOC Supervisor will review and monitor the tasks of the GSOC Operator and provide necessary guidance and support, as required by the GSOC Operator. The GSOC Supervisor will facilitate the timely delivery of high-quality security risk advice, will communicate with different internal stakeholders and will incorporate feedback from QatarEnergy into the day-to-day operations of the GSOC.

The GSOC Supervisor will also support security assessments relating to new and emerging market entry, conduct baseline threat monitoring and collate security risk information. The role will contribute to functional enhancement projects, support the identification and communication of security events affecting business travellers, and provide preliminary security risk assessments and advice during emerging global crises.

Additionally, the GSOC Supervisor will work closely with the GSOC Manager and the GSOC Operator in updating relevant operational processes.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Core Support to QatarEnergy**

* Support operational planning and readiness through the maintenance and development of security provider networks and the preparation of Concepts of Operations.
* Participate in projects relating to functional enhancements to ensure QatarEnergy maintains best-in-class security assistance capabilities.
* Ensure client awareness of the current security environment in countries across the region of responsibility.
* Travel, as required, to countries within the region to assess the security situation, evaluate local provider capabilities and expand the existing network of security contacts to support clients and operational planning.
* Support new and emerging market entry assessments by conducting baseline threat monitoring and collating relevant security risk information.
* Identify and communicate high-impact, time-sensitive security events to business travellers and internal stakeholders.
* Provide preliminary security risk assessments and advice during emerging global crises, escalating requests for assistance to the GSOC Manager, QatarEnergy Senior Leadership and International SOS Assistance Centre, as appropriate.
* Work closely with the GSOC Manager and GSOC Operator to review and update operational processes.

### 

### **Global Threat Monitoring**

* Oversee and validate threat monitoring conducted by Operators to ensure accuracy and relevance.
* Conduct baseline and enhanced threat assessments, including for new and emerging markets.
* Collate and analyse security risk data to support strategic and operational decision-making.
* Ensure timely escalation of high-impact or time-sensitive threats to stakeholders and leadership.

### 

### **Travel Security Risk Management**

  

* Supervise the delivery of travel security advice, ensuring consistency with client requirements and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
* Support the identification and communication of destination-specific risks to business travellers and stakeholders.
* Review incident tracking and reporting to ensure quality, accuracy and completeness.
* Facilitate coordination with internal stakeholders and external assistance providers, where required.

### 

### **Crisis & Emergency Management**

  

* Act as the primary escalation point for Operators during incidents and crises.
* Provide preliminary crisis assessments and security advice to stakeholders.
* Coordinate GSOC response activities and ensure effective information flow during incidents.
* Escalate critical situations to the GSOC Manager, senior leadership and external support entities, as required.
* Support updates and improvements to operational processes and crisis response frameworks

**Required Skills & Knowledge**
-------------------------------

* Strong knowledge of security risk management principles and best practices across diverse operational environments.
* Demonstrated experience in security risk monitoring, intelligence analysis and incident assessment.
* Good understanding of the geopolitical and security landscape within QatarEnergy’s Region of Operations.
* Ability to review, validate and enhance intelligence outputs and risk assessments produced by Operators.
* Proficiency in coordinating security assistance tasks, including travel risk management and incident response.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey security risks and advice to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to analyse multiple streams of security, threat and logistical information under time pressure and provide actionable recommendations.
* Familiarity with GSOC operations, escalation protocols and crisis response frameworks.
* Competent IT skills, including Microsoft Office Suite and relevant operational platforms.

**Required Work Experience**
----------------------------

* Typically, 5–7 years’ experience in security risk management, intelligence analysis or GSOC operations within military, government, NGO or private sector roles.
* Experience in monitoring global threats and providing security risk assessments.
* Experience in supervising or mentoring junior staff in an operational environment.
* Experience in incident management, travel risk management or crisis response support.
* Experience in producing and reviewing reports for internal stakeholders and decision-makers.

### 

### **Preferred Experience**

* Exposure to crisis management and business continuity processes.
* Experience working in QatarEnergy’s Region of Operations or similar high-risk environments.
* Experience in client-facing or stakeholder coordination roles.
* Experience supporting new market entry or risk assessments.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Educated to a degree level (or equivalent professional training and experience) in security studies, risk management, international relations, political science or a related field.
* Relevant professional certifications in security or risk management (desirable).

**Required Languages**
----------------------

* Excellent spoken and written English language.
* Additional language skills (Arabic, French, etc.) desirable.

Title: Project Engineer - Controls Systems
Description:
### **What You Will Do**

The Project Engineer - Controls will report directly to the Branch Manager and will be based in Qatar. As part of the Controls & Building Automation Systems (BAS) team, you will be responsible for the engineering, design review, project execution, testing, commissioning, and successful delivery of Building Management System (BMS) and Integrated Controls projects across multiple client sites.

You will work closely with customers, subcontractors, consultants, and internal stakeholders to ensure projects are delivered safely, on time, within budget, and in accordance with customer specifications and company standards. This role offers an excellent opportunity to develop advanced technical, project management, and customer engagement skills within a dynamic environment.

### **How You Will Do It**

As a Project Engineer - Controls, you will leverage your technical expertise in BMS and Building Automation Systems to support all phases of project execution, from engineering and design review through commissioning and handover.

You will:

* Execute BMS, HVAC Controls, and Building Automation projects in accordance with project schedules, technical specifications, and quality standards.
* Review project specifications, drawings, sequences of operation, and control schematics to ensure compliance with client and consultant requirements.
* Prepare engineering submittals, technical documentation, method statements, and project reports.
* Coordinate with clients, consultants, contractors, and suppliers to facilitate smooth project execution and timely issue resolution.
* Configure, program, and commission BMS controllers, supervisory systems, field devices, and network integrations.
* Perform functional testing, point-to-point verification, system integration, and site acceptance testing.
* Provide technical support during installation, startup, testing, and commissioning activities.
* Monitor project progress and proactively identify risks, delays, and technical challenges, recommending corrective actions where necessary.
* Ensure compliance with project quality requirements, company procedures, and HSE standards throughout project execution.
* Manage subcontractors and site teams to ensure adherence to project schedules and delivery milestones.
* Assist in project planning, resource allocation, procurement coordination, and material management activities.
* Support project closeout activities, including preparation of as-built documentation, O&M manuals, training, and client handover.
* Prepare progress reports and maintain effective communication with all project stakeholders.

### **What We Look For**

**Required**

* Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Automation, or Control Engineering.
* Minimum 5-6 years of experience in the design, engineering, execution, or commissioning of Building Management Systems (BMS), Building Automation Systems (BAS), or Controls projects.
* Proven experience in HVAC controls, chiller plant controls, energy management systems, and building automation applications.
* Strong understanding of control system architectures, field devices, communication protocols, and system integrations including BACnet, Modbus, LonWorks, and TCP/IP networking.
* Ability to read and interpret electrical drawings, control schematics, sequence of operations, specifications, and technical submittals.
* Experience in system programming, controller configuration, graphics development, and commissioning activities.
* Knowledge of project execution methodologies, risk management, and quality control processes.
* Strong understanding of project documentation, contractual requirements, and client communications.
* Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.

* Valid Qatar driving license.
* Strong client-facing, interpersonal, and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently while effectively managing multiple stakeholders and project priorities.

**Preferred**

* Experience working on large-scale commercial, healthcare, data center, hospitality, or infrastructure projects within the GCC region.

Title: Provider Operations Specialist
Description:
**Build better healthcare together**

Maple’s purpose is to meet the world's healthcare needs. We’re Canada's leading on-demand healthcare platform, connecting patients with Canadian-licensed doctors, nurse practitioners and specialists. Today, we’re proud that over 8 million patients and 7,000 businesses and government partners have access to same-day, proactive and ongoing care. We enable people to take control of their health and push the boundaries of what’s possible every day.

Bold minds. Big impact. A career at Maple is about making an impact. We empower bold thinking, surround you with an inspiring team and are driven by a motivating purpose. Here, you’ll do work that changes lives—including your own.

### **The role**

As a Provider Operations Specialist, you'll help keep Maple's provider network running smoothly across three areas: Provider Success, Network Performance, and Process Operations.

You'll support everything from provider onboarding and billing to platform updates, performance monitoring, and internal team coordination. You'll work with teams across Maple to solve problems, keep day-to-day operations on track, and find ways to make our processes simpler and more efficient.

### **Your responsibilities**

As a Provider Operations Specialist, you'll:

* Respond to provider questions and resolve operational issues promptly.
* Coordinate provider onboarding to ensure a smooth experience from start to finish.
* Coordinate provider communications, ensuring providers have the information and support they need.
* Support platform setup and configuration, including updates to specialties, provider segments, and product features.
* Support platform testing and quality assurance to ensure everything works as intended.
* Support provider billing and payment processes.
* Coordinate administrative activities related to provider complaints.
* Track regulatory updates and support recurring operational processes.
* Act as a point of contact for internal teams, handling routine requests through channels like Slack and escalating more complex issues.
* Contribute to maintaining team documentation, trackers, procedures, and knowledge base resources to keep information accurate and up to date.
* Contribute to identifying ways to simplify and improve workflows.

### **What success looks like**

**In your first 90 days, you'll:**

* Build strong relationships with your team and key partners while learning Maple's systems, workflows, and provider network operations.
* Get comfortable supporting day-to-day activities across Provider Success, Network Performance, Process Operations, and Team Administration.
* Start handling provider and internal support requests, onboarding activities, billing tasks, and other recurring processes with increasing independence.

**In 12–18 months, you'll:**

* Be a trusted resource for providers and internal teams, independently owning a wide range of operational tasks and knowing when to escalate issues.
* Take ownership of recurring processes across billing, onboarding, reporting, platform configuration, and team coordination.
* Contribute to identifying ways to simplify and improve workflows, helping the team work more efficiently and deliver a better provider experience.

### **What you bring**

* An undergraduate degree in business, commerce, health administration, communications or a related field, with 2+ years of experience in an operations support role or similar.
* Foundational experience conducting varied operational work and following established processes to resolve routine issues.
* Strong organization — you can work on multiple workstreams carefully, keep moving parts on track and maintain accurate records.
* A proactive communication style — you keep partners informed, flag issues early and make it easy for the team to know where things stand.
* Strong written communication skills — you can respond to inbound inquiries clearly, warmly and professionally.
* Strong prioritization and problem-solving skills — you can balance recurring work with ad-hoc requests, resolve what you can and know when to escalate.
* A collaborative, service-oriented mindset — you enjoy connecting people, teams and work streams.
* Comfortable using AI tools to work more efficiently — you look for opportunities to simplify tasks, improve workflows and make everyday work easier.

Play to your strengths. Finding the right fit goes both ways—so this section is yours to complete. When you join, you'll add the unique strengths you bring that aren't captured above.

### **How we'll support you**

We recognise our people's health is everything. That's why we take care of them.

* **Maple for you and your family:** 24/7 access to general practitioners, pediatrics and mental health therapy for you and your family. Care starts on day one
* **Comprehensive health coverage:** Medical, dental and life insurance because your peace of mind—and your loved ones—matter most
* **Health spending account:** Extra funds to cover the essentials that make a difference, from new glasses to specialised therapy
* **Flex benefits:** An annual budget built for your growth and well-being. Use it for professional development, wellness expenses or a one-time boost to your retirement savings. You choose what matters most
* **Health days:** Life happens. We provide 10 dedicated days for rest, medical appointments or caregiving, so you can show up at your best
* **Destination days:** Work from anywhere. Enjoy the flexibility to work internationally in eligible countries for up to five days per year
* **Group retirement savings plan:** We're here for the long haul. Invest in your future with our group retirement plan

### **The details**

* **Job type:** New role, full-time
* **Hiring manager:** Manager, Provider Network Operations
* **Location:** Hybrid, 500 King Street West, Toronto
* **Start date:** December 2026
* **Vacation:** 3 weeks
* **Pay range:** $56,000 – $63,000

Offers can vary depending on skills, experience and readiness to meet Maple's expectations for this level. We encourage open conversations about pay. If you have questions about how compensation works at Maple, you're welcome to ask at any point in the interview process.

Description:
